62  SgPragmaDeclaration&
63  createPragma_common(Element_Struct& el, SgStatement* stmtOpt, AstContext ctx)
64  {
65  ADA_ASSERT (el.Element_Kind == A_Pragma);
66  logKind("A_Pragma", el.ID);
67 
68  Pragma_Struct& pragma = el.The_Union.The_Pragma;
69  std::string name{pragma.Pragma_Name_Image};
70  ElemIdRange argRange = idRange(pragma.Pragma_Argument_Associations);
71  SgExprListExp& arglist = mkExprListExp();
72  SgPragmaDeclaration& sgnode = mkPragmaDeclaration(name, arglist, stmtOpt);
73  ADA_ASSERT (arglist.get_parent());
74 
75  sgnode.set_parent(&ctx.scope()); // set fictitious parent (will be overwritten when pragma is actually placed)
76 
77  std::vector<SgExpression*> args = traverseIDs(argRange, elemMap(), ArgListCreator{ctx.pragmaAspectAnchor(sgnode)});
78 
79  arglist.get_expressions().reserve(args.size());
80  for (SgExpression* arg : args) arglist.append_expression(arg);
81 
82  // \todo do we need to privatize pragmas in the private section?
83  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, el, ctx);
84  attachSourceLocation(SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_pragma()), el, ctx);
85  recordNode(asisDecls(), el.ID, sgnode);
86 
87  return sgnode;
88  }

262  void operator()(SgPragmaDeclaration* pragma)

266  ADA_ASSERT (pragma);

273  iterator beg = all.begin();
274  iterator lim = all.end();

276  pragma->get_startOfConstruct(),
277  SourceLocationLessThan{}
278  );
279 
280  // The following if-else structure gives preference
281  // to inserting the pragma into the first scope.

283  if (pos == lim)
284  SageInterface::appendStatement(pragma, &last);
285  else if (pos == beg)
286  SageInterface::insertStatementBefore(*pos, pragma);
287  else
288  SageInterface::insertStatementAfter(*std::prev(pos), pragma); // gives preference to end of first scope
289 
290  // insert into combined list
291  all.insert(pos, pragma);
292 
293  if (false) // debug all.insert \todo remove
294  {
295  bool sorted = all.end() == std::adjacent_find( all.begin(), all.end(),
296  [](const SgLocatedNode* lhs, const SgLocatedNode* rhs)
297  {
298  return SourceLocationLessThan{}(rhs, lhs);
299  }
300  );
301 
302  if (!sorted)
303  {
304  if (pos == lim) logTrace() << "lim" << std::endl;
305  else if (pos == beg) logTrace() << "beg" << std::endl;
306  else logTrace() << "mid" << std::endl;
307  }
308 
309  ADA_ASSERT(sorted);
310  }
311  }

320  // records all pragmas in the range \ref pragmas so that they can processed at the end of the block
321  // \note this is necessary because it seems that Asis does not store pragmas on declare blocks
322  // (field Statement::Pragmas).
323  void recordPragmasID(std::vector<Element_ID> pragmas, SgStatement* stmt, AstContext ctx)
324  {
325  if (pragmas.empty()) return;
326 
327  if (!ctx.collectsPragmas())
328  {
329  logFlaw() << "no place to collect available pragmas.." << std::endl;
330  return;
331  }
332 
333  AstContext::PragmaContainer& cont = ctx.pragmas();
334 
335  std::transform( pragmas.begin(), pragmas.end(),
336  std::back_inserter(cont),
337  [stmt](Element_ID id) -> ExtendedPragmaID { return { id, stmt }; }
338  );
339  }

341  void placePragmas(std::vector<SgScopeStatement*> scopes, AstContext ctx)
342  {
343  ADA_ASSERT(scopes.size() > 0);
344 
345  using PragmaNodes = PragmaCreator::result_container;
346  using PragmaContainer = AstContext::PragmaContainer;
347 
348  PragmaContainer& allpragmas = ctx.pragmas();
349 
350  if (allpragmas.empty()) return; // early exit to prevent scope flattening
351 
352  // sort pragmas by id, stmt
353  auto byIdStmt = [](const ExtendedPragmaID& lhs, const ExtendedPragmaID& rhs) -> bool
354  {
355  if (lhs.id() < rhs.id()) return true;
356  if (lhs.id() > rhs.id()) return false;
357 
358  // if ids equal, sort entries with statements before nullptr statements
359  return lhs.stmt() > rhs.stmt();
360  };
361 
362  std::sort(allpragmas.begin(), allpragmas.end(), byIdStmt);
363 
364  // remove duplicate pragma IDs, since any entry with an associated stmt is sorted before
365  // entries without associated stmt (nullptr), the entry with associated stmt survives.
366  auto idEquality = [](const ExtendedPragmaID& lhs, const ExtendedPragmaID& rhs) -> bool
367  {
368  return lhs.id() == rhs.id();
369  };
370  auto const lim = std::unique(allpragmas.begin(), allpragmas.end(), idEquality);
371 
372  // generate declarations for pragmas and place them in file-lexicographical order
373  PragmaNodes pragmadcls = std::for_each(allpragmas.begin(), lim, PragmaCreator{elemMap(), ctx});
374 
375  std::sort(pragmadcls.begin(), pragmadcls.end(), SourceLocationLessThan{});
376 
377  // retroactively place pragmas according to their source position information
378  std::for_each(pragmadcls.begin(), pragmadcls.end(), PragmaPlacer{std::move(scopes), ctx});
379  }

1023  struct TypeDeclMaker : sg::DispatchHandler<SgDeclarationStatement*>

1087  setModifiers(rec, foundation);

1091  operator SgDeclarationStatement& () const

1111 
1112  SgDeclarationStatement&
1113  handleNumVarCstDecl( Element_Struct& elem,
1114  Declaration_Struct& decl,
1115  AstContext ctx,
1116  bool isPrivate,
1117  SgType& dclType,
1118  SgType* expectedType = nullptr
1119  )
1120  {
1121  typedef NameCreator::result_container name_container;
1122 
1123  ElemIdRange range = idRange(decl.Names);
1124  name_container names = allNames(range, ctx);
1125  SgScopeStatement& scope = ctx.scope();
1126  //
1127  // https://www.adaic.com/resources/add_content/standards/05rm/html/RM-3-3-1.html#S0032
1128  // $7: Any declaration that includes a defining_identifier_list with more than one defining_identifier
1129  // is equivalent to a series of declarations each containing one defining_identifier from the list,
1130  // with the rest of the text of the declaration copied for each declaration in the series, in the
1131  // same order as the list. The remainder of this International Standard relies on this equivalence;
1132  // explanations are given for declarations with a single defining_identifier.
1133  // => clone the initializing expression instead of creating references to the first one..
1134  SgInitializedNamePtrList dclnames = constructInitializedNamePtrList( ctx,
1135  asisVars(),
1136  names,
1137  dclType,
1138  getVarInit(decl, expectedType, ctx)
1139  );
1140  SgVariableDeclaration& sgnode = mkVarDecl(dclnames, scope);
1141 
1142  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
1143  privatize(sgnode, isPrivate);
1144  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
1145  return sgnode;
1146  }

1171  std::pair<SgAdaTaskSpec*, DeferredPragmaBodyCompletion>
1172  getTaskSpec(Element_Struct& elem, AstContext ctx)
1173  {
1174  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == A_Definition);
1175  logKind("A_Definition", elem.ID);
1176 
1177  Definition_Struct& def = elem.The_Union.Definition;
1178  ADA_ASSERT (def.Definition_Kind == A_Task_Definition);
1179 
1180  logKind("A_Task_Definition", elem.ID);
1181 
1182  Task_Definition_Struct* tasknode = &def.The_Union.The_Task_Definition;
1183  SgAdaTaskSpec& sgnode = mkAdaTaskSpec();
1184  SgAdaTaskSpec* nodePtr = &sgnode;
1185 
1186  // sgnode.set_hasMembers(true);
1187  sgnode.set_hasPrivate(tasknode->Is_Private_Present);
1188 
1189  auto deferred = [ctx,nodePtr,tasknode](AstContext::PragmaContainer pragmas) -> void
1190  {
1191  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pragmas);
1192 
1193  // visible items
1194  {
1195  ElemIdRange range = idRange(tasknode->Visible_Part_Items);
1196 
1197  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), ElemCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(*nodePtr)});
1198  }
1199 
1200  // private items
1201  {
1202  ElemIdRange range = idRange(tasknode->Private_Part_Items);
1203  ADA_ASSERT ((!range.empty()) == tasknode->Is_Private_Present);
1204 
1205  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), ElemCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(*nodePtr), true /* private items */});
1206  }
1207 
1208  placePragmas({ nodePtr }, pragmaCtx.scope(*nodePtr));
1209  };
1210 
1211  /* unused fields: (Task_Definition_Struct)
1212  bool Has_Task;
1213  Declaration_List Corresponding_Type_Operators;
1214  */
1215  return std::make_pair(&sgnode, deferred);
1216  }

1218  void nothingToComplete(AstContext::PragmaContainer pragmas)
1219  {
1220  ADA_ASSERT(pragmas.empty());

1253  std::pair<SgAdaProtectedSpec*, DeferredPragmaBodyCompletion>

1326  struct CaseStmtCreator
1327  {
1328  typedef std::pair<SgExpression*, SgStatement*> branch_type;
1329  typedef std::vector<branch_type> branch_container;
1330 
1331  CaseStmtCreator(AstContext astctx, SgSwitchStatement& caseStmt)
1332  : ctx(astctx), caseNode(caseStmt)
1333  {}
1334 
1335  bool isWhenOthers(ElemIdRange choices)
1336  {
1337  ADA_ASSERT (!choices.empty());
1338 
1339  if (choices.size() > 1) return false;
1340 
1341  Element_Struct& el = retrieveElem(elemMap(), *choices.first);
1342 
1343  return ( el.Element_Kind == A_Definition
1344  && el.The_Union.Definition.Definition_Kind == An_Others_Choice
1345  );
1346  }
1347 
1348  void operator()(Element_Struct& elem)
1349  {
1350  Path_Struct& path = elem.The_Union.Path;
1351 
1352  switch (path.Path_Kind)
1353  {
1354  case A_Case_Path:
1355  {
1356  logKind("A_Case_Path", elem.ID);
1357 
1358  SgStatement* sgnode = nullptr;
1359  // \todo can we create the sequence without introducing a block?
1360  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
1361  ElemIdRange caseChoices = idRange(path.Case_Path_Alternative_Choices);
1362 
1363  if (isWhenOthers(caseChoices))
1364  {
1365  logKind("An_Others_Choice");
1366 
1367  SgDefaultOptionStmt* whenOthersNode = &mkWhenOthersPath(block);
1368 
1369  caseNode.append_default(whenOthersNode);
1370  sgnode = whenOthersNode;
1371  }
1372  else
1373  {
1374  std::vector<SgExpression*> choices = traverseIDs(caseChoices, elemMap(), ExprSeqCreator{ctx});
1375 
1376  // \todo reconsider the "reuse" of SgCommaOp
1377  // SgCommaOp is only used to separate discrete choices in case-when
1378  ADA_ASSERT (choices.size());
1379  SgExpression& caseCond = mkChoiceExpIfNeeded(std::move(choices));
1380  SgCaseOptionStmt* whenNode = &mkWhenPath(caseCond, block);
1381 
1382  caseNode.append_case(whenNode);
1383  sgnode = whenNode;
1384  }
1385 
1386  ADA_ASSERT (sgnode);
1387  ElemIdRange caseBlock = idRange(path.Sequence_Of_Statements);
1388 
1389  traverseIDs(caseBlock, elemMap(), StmtCreator{ctx.scope(block)});
1390  attachSourceLocation(*sgnode, elem, ctx);
1391  break;
1392  }
1393 
1394  default:
1395  ADA_ASSERT(false);
1396  }
1397  }
1398 
1399  private:
1400  AstContext ctx;
1401  SgSwitchStatement& caseNode; // \todo consider introducing SgAdaCaseStmt
1402  };
1403 
1404  struct IfStmtCreator
1405  {
1406  IfStmtCreator(SgIfStmt& sgnode, AstContext astctx)
1407  : ifStmt(&sgnode), ctx(astctx)
1408  {}
1409 
1410  void commonBranch(Path_Struct& path, void (SgIfStmt::*branchSetter)(SgStatement*))
1411  {
1412  ElemIdRange thenStmts = idRange(path.Sequence_Of_Statements);
1413  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
1414 
1415  sg::linkParentChild(SG_DEREF(ifStmt), static_cast<SgStatement&>(block), branchSetter);
1416  traverseIDs(thenStmts, elemMap(), StmtCreator{ctx.scope(block)});
1417  }
1418 
1419  void conditionedBranch(Path_Struct& path)
1420  {
1421  SgExpression& condExpr = getExprID(path.Condition_Expression, ctx);
1422  SgStatement& condStmt = mkExprStatement(condExpr);
1423 
1424  sg::linkParentChild(SG_DEREF(ifStmt), condStmt, &SgIfStmt::set_conditional);
1425  commonBranch(path, &SgIfStmt::set_true_body);
1426  }
1427 
1428  void operator()(Element_Struct& elem)
1429  {
1430  Path_Struct& path = elem.The_Union.Path;
1431 
1432  switch (path.Path_Kind)
1433  {
1434  case An_If_Path:
1435  {
1436  logKind("An_If_Path", elem.ID);
1437  ADA_ASSERT (ifStmt);
1438  conditionedBranch(path);
1439  break;
1440  }
1441 
1442  case An_Elsif_Path:
1443  {
1444  logKind("An_Elsif_Path", elem.ID);
1445  ADA_ASSERT (ifStmt);
1446 
1447  SgIfStmt& cascadingIf = mkIfStmt(true /* elsif */);
1448 
1449  sg::linkParentChild( SG_DEREF(ifStmt),
1450  static_cast<SgStatement&>(cascadingIf),
1451  &SgIfStmt::set_false_body
1452  );
1453  ifStmt = &cascadingIf;
1454  conditionedBranch(path);
1455  break;
1456  }
1457 
1458  case An_Else_Path:
1459  {
1460  logKind("An_Else_Path", elem.ID);
1461  ADA_ASSERT (ifStmt);
1462  commonBranch(path, &SgIfStmt::set_false_body);
1463  break;
1464  }
1465 
1466  default:
1467  ADA_ASSERT(false);
1468  }
1469  }
1470 
1471  private:
1472  SgIfStmt* ifStmt;
1473  AstContext ctx;
1474 
1475  IfStmtCreator() = delete;
1476  };
1477 
1478  // MS 11/17/2020 : SelectStmtCreator modeled on IfStmtCreator
1479  // PP 10/12/2021 : modified code to eliminate the need for using scope_npc.
1480  // A block will only be populated after the new node has been connected
1481  // to the AST. This is achieved by returning a lambda function w/o parameters
1482  // (DeferredBodyCompletion) that is invoked after the node has been connected
1483  // to the AST.
1484  struct SelectStmtCreator
1485  {
1486  typedef SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt* alternative;
1487  typedef std::vector<alternative> alternative_container;
1488 
1489  SelectStmtCreator(SgAdaSelectStmt& sgn, AstContext astctx)
1490  : sgnode(&sgn), ctx(astctx)
1491  {}
1492 
1493  std::pair<SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt*, DeferredSimpleBodyCompletion>
1494  commonAltStmt(Path_Struct& path) {
1495  // create body of alternative
1496  SgBasicBlock* block = &mkBasicBlock();
1497 
1498  // create guard
1499  SgExpression& guard = getExprID_opt(path.Guard, ctx);
1500 
1501  // instantiate SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt node and return it
1502  SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt& stmt = mkAdaSelectAlternativeStmt(guard, *block);
1503  Path_Struct* pathptr = &path;
1504  AstContext astctx{ctx};
1505 
1506  auto completion = [pathptr, block, astctx]() -> void
1507  {
1508  ElemIdRange altStmts = idRange(pathptr->Sequence_Of_Statements);
1509 
1510  traverseIDs(altStmts, elemMap(), StmtCreator{astctx.scope(*block)});
1511  };
1512 
1513  return std::make_pair(&stmt, completion);
1514  }
1515 
1516  std::pair<SgBasicBlock*, DeferredSimpleBodyCompletion>
1517  commonMakeBlock(Path_Struct& path) {
1518  SgBasicBlock* block = &mkBasicBlock();
1519  Path_Struct* pathptr = &path;
1520  AstContext astctx{ctx};
1521 
1522  auto completion = [pathptr, block, astctx]() -> void
1523  {
1524  ElemIdRange altStmts = idRange(pathptr->Sequence_Of_Statements);
1525 
1526  traverseIDs(altStmts, elemMap(), StmtCreator{astctx.scope(*block)});
1527  };
1528  return std::make_pair(block, completion);
1529  }
1530 
1531  void orAlternative(Path_Struct& path)
1532  {
1533  ADA_ASSERT (path.Path_Kind == An_Or_Path);
1534 
1535  auto alt = commonAltStmt(path);
1536 
1537  if (currOrPath == nullptr)
1538  {
1539  ADA_ASSERT ( (sgnode->get_select_type() == SgAdaSelectStmt::e_selective_accept)
1540  || (sgnode->get_select_type() == SgAdaSelectStmt::e_timed_entry)
1541  );
1542 
1543  sg::linkParentChild(*sgnode, *(alt.first), &SgAdaSelectStmt::set_or_path);
1544  }
1545  else
1546  {
1547  ADA_ASSERT (sgnode->get_select_type() == SgAdaSelectStmt::e_selective_accept);
1548 
1549  sg::linkParentChild(*currOrPath, *(alt.first), &SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt::set_next);
1550  }
1551 
1552  currOrPath = alt.first;
1553  alt.second();
1554  }
1555 
1556  void selectAlternative(Path_Struct& path)
1557  {
1558  ADA_ASSERT (path.Path_Kind == A_Select_Path);
1559  auto alt = commonAltStmt(path);
1560 
1561  sg::linkParentChild(*sgnode, *(alt.first), &SgAdaSelectStmt::set_select_path);
1562  alt.second();
1563  }
1564 
1565  void elseAlternative(Path_Struct& path)
1566  {
1567  ADA_ASSERT (path.Path_Kind == An_Else_Path);
1568  ADA_ASSERT ( (sgnode->get_select_type() == SgAdaSelectStmt::e_selective_accept)
1569  || (sgnode->get_select_type() == SgAdaSelectStmt::e_conditional_entry)
1570  );
1571 
1572  auto alt = commonMakeBlock(path);
1573 
1574  sg::linkParentChild(*sgnode, *(alt.first), &SgAdaSelectStmt::set_else_path);
1575  alt.second();
1576  }
1577 
1578  void abortAlternative(Path_Struct& path)
1579  {
1580  ADA_ASSERT (path.Path_Kind == A_Then_Abort_Path);
1581  ADA_ASSERT (sgnode->get_select_type() == SgAdaSelectStmt::e_asynchronous);
1582 
1583  auto alt = commonMakeBlock(path);
1584 
1585  sg::linkParentChild(*sgnode, *(alt.first), &SgAdaSelectStmt::set_abort_path);
1586  alt.second();
1587  }
1588 
1589  void operator()(Element_Struct& elem)
1590  {
1591  Path_Struct& path = elem.The_Union.Path;
1592 
1593  switch (path.Path_Kind)
1594  {
1595  case A_Select_Path:
1596  {
1597  selectAlternative(path);
1598  break;
1599  }
1600 
1601  case An_Or_Path:
1602  {
1603  orAlternative(path);
1604  break;
1605  }
1606 
1607  case An_Else_Path:
1608  {
1609  elseAlternative(path);
1610  break;
1611  }
1612 
1613  case A_Then_Abort_Path:
1614  {
1615  abortAlternative(path);
1616  break;
1617  }
1618 
1619  default:
1620  ADA_ASSERT(false);
1621  }
1622  }
1623 
1624  private:
1625  SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt* currOrPath = nullptr;
1626  SgAdaSelectStmt* sgnode = nullptr;
1627  AstContext ctx;
1628 
1629  SelectStmtCreator() = delete;
1630  };

1640  ADA_ASSERT (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Loop_Parameter_Specification);
1641 
1642  return !decl.Has_Reverse;
1643  }

1645  //
1646  // combined block and declarative body handling
1647 
1648  //~ using TryBlockNodes = std::pair<SgTryStmt*, std::reference_wrapper<SgBasicBlock> >;
1649  using TryBlockNodes = std::pair<SgTryStmt*, std::reference_wrapper<SgScopeStatement> >;
1650 
1651  SgScopeStatement&
1652  createBlockIfNeeded(bool newStatementBlock, AstContext ctx)
1653  {
1654  if (!newStatementBlock) return ctx.scope();
1655 
1656  SgBasicBlock& newblk = mkBasicBlock();

1658  ctx.appendStatement(newblk);

1669  TryBlockNodes
1670  createTryOrBlockIfNeeded(bool hasHandlers, bool requiresStmtBlock, AstContext ctx)
1671  {
1672  if (!hasHandlers) return TryBlockNodes{nullptr, createBlockIfNeeded(requiresStmtBlock, ctx)};
1673 
1674  SgBasicBlock& tryBlock = mkBasicBlock();
1675  SgTryStmt& tryStmt = mkTryStmt(tryBlock);
1676 
1677  ctx.appendStatement(tryStmt);
1678 
1679  return TryBlockNodes{&tryStmt, tryBlock};

1683  using BlockHandler = std::function<void(Statement_List, SgScopeStatement&, AstContext ctx)>;
1684  using ExceptionHandlerHandler = std::function<void(ElemIdRange, SgScopeStatement&, SgTryStmt&, AstContext ctx)>;
1685 
1686  // a simple block handler just traverses the statement list and adds them to the \ref blk.
1687  void simpleBlockHandler(Statement_List bodyStatements, SgScopeStatement& blk, AstContext ctx)
1688  {
1689  ElemIdRange range = idRange(bodyStatements);
1690 
1691  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), StmtCreator{ctx.scope(blk)});
1692  }
1693 
1694  // at some point loops, labels, gotos need to be patched up. In this case, we do that at the
1695  // end of a routine through the use of the LoopAndLabelManager.
1696  void routineBlockHandler(Statement_List bodyStatements, SgScopeStatement& blk, AstContext ctx)
1697  {
1698  LabelAndLoopManager lblmgr;
1699 
1700  simpleBlockHandler(bodyStatements, blk, ctx.labelsAndLoops(lblmgr));
1701  }
1702 
1703  void simpleExceptionBlockHandler(ElemIdRange handlers, SgScopeStatement& blk, SgTryStmt& trystmt, AstContext ctx)
1704  {
1705  traverseIDs(handlers, elemMap(), ExHandlerCreator{ctx.scope(blk), trystmt});
1706  }
1707 
1708  // at some point loops, labels, gotos need to be patched up. In this case, we do that at the
1709  // end of a routine through the use of the LoopAndLabelManager
1710  void routineExceptionBlockHandler(ElemIdRange handlers, SgScopeStatement& blk, SgTryStmt& trystmt, AstContext ctx)
1711  {
1712  LabelAndLoopManager lblmgr;
1713 
1714  simpleExceptionBlockHandler(handlers, blk, trystmt, ctx.labelsAndLoops(lblmgr));
1715  }

1717  // completes any block with exception handlers and pragmas attached
1718  void completeHandledBlock( Statement_List bodyStatements,
1719  Exception_Handler_List exceptionHandlers,
1720  Pragma_Element_ID_List pragmas,
1721  BlockHandler blockHandler,
1722  ExceptionHandlerHandler exhandlerHandler,
1723  SgScopeStatement& dominantBlock,
1724  bool requiresStatementBlock,
1725  AstContext ctx,
1726  AstContext::PragmaContainer pendingPragmas = {} // moved in to capture pragmas seen earlier
1727  )
1728  {
1729  using ScopeSequence = std::vector<SgScopeStatement*>;
1730 
1731  ElemIdRange hndlrs = idRange(exceptionHandlers);
1732  TryBlockNodes trydata = createTryOrBlockIfNeeded( hndlrs.size() > 0, requiresStatementBlock, ctx.scope(dominantBlock));
1733  SgTryStmt* trystmt = trydata.first;
1734  SgScopeStatement& stmtblk = trydata.second;
1735  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
1736  ScopeSequence activeScopes = { &dominantBlock };
1737 
1738  if (&dominantBlock != &stmtblk)
1739  activeScopes.push_back(&stmtblk);
1740 
1741  blockHandler(bodyStatements, stmtblk, pragmaCtx);
1742 
1743  if (trystmt)
1744  exhandlerHandler(hndlrs, dominantBlock, *trystmt, pragmaCtx);
1745 
1746  processAndPlacePragmas(pragmas, std::move(activeScopes), pragmaCtx.scope(dominantBlock));
1747  }
1748 
1749 
1750 
1751  // completes any block with declarative items and exception handlers and pragmas attached
1752  void completeDeclarationsWithHandledBlock( Element_ID_List declarativeItems,
1753  Statement_List bodyStatements,
1754  Exception_Handler_List exceptionHandlers,
1755  Pragma_Element_ID_List pragmas,
1756  BlockHandler blockHandler,
1757  ExceptionHandlerHandler exhandlerHandler,
1758  SgScopeStatement& dominantBlock,
1759  bool requiresStatementBlock,
1760  AstContext ctx
1761  )
1762  {
1763  using PragmaContainer = AstContext::PragmaContainer;
1764 
1765  ElemIdRange range = idRange(declarativeItems);
1766  PragmaContainer pendingPragmas;
1767  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
1768 
1769  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), ElemCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(dominantBlock)});
1770 
1771  completeHandledBlock( bodyStatements,
1772  exceptionHandlers,
1773  pragmas,
1774  blockHandler,
1775  exhandlerHandler,
1776  dominantBlock,
1777  requiresStatementBlock,
1778  pragmaCtx,
1779  std::move(pendingPragmas)
1780  );
1781  }

1783  void completeRoutineBody(Declaration_Struct& decl, SgBasicBlock& declblk, AstContext ctx)

1785  completeDeclarationsWithHandledBlock( decl.Body_Declarative_Items,

1787  decl.Body_Exception_Handlers,
1788  decl.Pragmas,

1790  routineExceptionBlockHandler,
1791  declblk,
1792  false /* same block for declarations and statements */,
1793  ctx
1794  );

1797  // handles elements that can appear in a statement context (from a ROSE point of view)
1798  // besides statements this also includes declarations and clauses
1799  void handleStmt(Element_Struct& elem, AstContext ctx)
1800  {
1801  using PragmaContainer = AstContext::PragmaContainer;
1802 
1803  logTrace() << "a statement/decl/clause " << elem.Element_Kind << std::endl;
1804 
1805  if (elem.Element_Kind == A_Declaration)
1806  {
1807  handleDeclaration(elem, ctx);
1808  return;
1809  }
1810 
1811  if (elem.Element_Kind == A_Clause)
1812  {
1813  handleClause(elem, ctx);
1814  return;
1815  }
1816 
1817  if (elem.Element_Kind == A_Pragma)
1818  {
1819  handlePragma(elem, nullptr, ctx);
1820  return;
1821  }
1822 
1823  //~ logError() << ":: " << elem.Element_Kind << std::endl;
1824  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == A_Statement);
1825 
1826  SgStatement* assocstmt = nullptr;
1827  Statement_Struct& stmt = elem.The_Union.Statement;
1828  ElemIdRange pragmaRange = idRange(stmt.Corresponding_Pragmas);
1829  std::vector<Element_ID> pragmaVector;
1830 
1831  std::copy(pragmaRange.first, pragmaRange.second, std::back_inserter(pragmaVector));
1832 
1833  switch (stmt.Statement_Kind)
1834  {
1835  case A_Null_Statement: // 5.1
1836  {
1837  logKind("A_Null_Statement", elem.ID);
1838 
1839  SgNullStatement& sgnode = mkNullStatement();
1840 
1841  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
1842  /* unused fields:
1843  */
1844  assocstmt = &sgnode;
1845  break;
1846  }
1847 
1848  case An_Assignment_Statement: // 5.2
1849  {
1850  logKind("An_Assignment_Statement", elem.ID);
1851 
1852  SgExpression& lhs = getExprID(stmt.Assignment_Variable_Name, ctx);
1853  SgExpression& rhs = getExprID(stmt.Assignment_Expression, ctx);
1854  SgExprStatement& sgnode = mkAssignStmt(lhs, rhs);
1855  SgExpression& assign = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_expression());
1856 
1857  attachSourceLocation(assign, elem, ctx);
1858  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
1859  /* unused fields:
1860  */
1861  assocstmt = &sgnode;
1862  break;
1863  }
1864 
1865  case An_If_Statement: // 5.3
1866  {
1867  logKind("An_If_Statement", elem.ID);
1868 
1869  SgIfStmt& sgnode = mkIfStmt();
1870  ElemIdRange range = idRange(stmt.Statement_Paths);
1871 
1872  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
1873  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), IfStmtCreator{sgnode, ctx});
1874 
1875  /* unused fields:
1876  */
1877  assocstmt = &sgnode;
1878  break;
1879  }
1880 
1881  case A_Case_Statement: // 5.4
1882  {
1883  logKind("A_Case_Statement", elem.ID);
1884 
1885  SgExpression& caseexpr = getExprID(stmt.Case_Expression, ctx);
1886  SgBasicBlock& casebody = mkBasicBlock();
1887  SgSwitchStatement& sgnode = mkAdaCaseStmt(caseexpr, casebody);
1888 
1889  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
1890 
1891  ElemIdRange range = idRange(stmt.Statement_Paths);
1892 
1893  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), CaseStmtCreator{ctx.scope(casebody), sgnode});
1894  /* unused fields:
1895  */
1896  assocstmt = &sgnode;
1897  break;
1898  }
1899 
1900  case A_While_Loop_Statement: // 5.5
1901  {
1902  logKind("A_While_Loop_Statement", elem.ID);
1903 
1904  SgExpression& cond = getExprID(stmt.While_Condition, ctx);
1905  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
1906  ElemIdRange adaStmts = idRange(stmt.Loop_Statements);
1907  SgWhileStmt& sgnode = mkWhileStmt(cond, block);
1908 
1909  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx, stmt.Statement_Identifier);
1910  recordNode(ctx.labelsAndLoops().asisLoops(), elem.ID, sgnode);
1911 
1912  PragmaContainer pendingPragmas;
1913  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
1914 
1915  traverseIDs(adaStmts, elemMap(), StmtCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(block)});
1916  processAndPlacePragmas(stmt.Pragmas, { &block }, pragmaCtx); // pragmaCtx.scope(block) ?
1917  /* unused fields:
1918  Element_ID Corresponding_End_Name;
1919  */
1920  assocstmt = &sgnode;
1921  break;
1922  }
1923 
1924  case A_Loop_Statement: // 5.5
1925  {
1926  logKind("A_Loop_Statement", elem.ID);
1927 
1928  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
1929  ElemIdRange adaStmts = idRange(stmt.Loop_Statements);
1930  SgAdaLoopStmt& sgnode = mkAdaLoopStmt(block);
1931 
1932  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx, stmt.Statement_Identifier);
1933 
1934  recordNode(ctx.labelsAndLoops().asisLoops(), elem.ID, sgnode);
1935 
1936  PragmaContainer pendingPragmas;
1937  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
1938 
1939  traverseIDs(adaStmts, elemMap(), StmtCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(block)});
1940  processAndPlacePragmas(stmt.Pragmas, { &block }, pragmaCtx); // pragmaCtx.scope(block) ?
1941 
1942  /* unused fields:
1943  Element_ID Corresponding_End_Name;
1944  bool Is_Name_Repeated;
1945  */
1946  assocstmt = &sgnode;
1947  break;
1948  }
1949 
1950  case A_For_Loop_Statement: // 5.5
1951  {
1952  logKind("A_For_Loop_Statement", elem.ID);
1953 
1954  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
1955  SgForStatement& sgnode = mkForStatement(block);
1956  Element_Struct& forvar = retrieveElem(elemMap(), stmt.For_Loop_Parameter_Specification);
1957  SgForInitStatement& forini = SG_DEREF( sb::buildForInitStatement(sgnode.getStatementList()) );
1958 
1959  attachSourceLocation(forini, forvar, ctx);
1960  sg::linkParentChild(sgnode, forini, &SgForStatement::set_for_init_stmt);
1961  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx, stmt.Statement_Identifier);
1962  handleDeclaration(forvar, ctx.scope(sgnode));
1963 
1964  // this swap is needed, b/c SgForInitStatement is not a scope
1965  // and when the loop variable declaration is created, the declaration
1966  // is pushed to the wrong statement list.
1967  ADA_ASSERT (sgnode.getStatementList().size() == 1);
1968  std::swap(forini.get_init_stmt(), block.get_statements());
1969 
1970  SgVariableDeclaration* inductionVar = isSgVariableDeclaration(forini.get_init_stmt().front());
1971  SgExpression& direction = mkForLoopIncrement(isForwardLoop(forvar), SG_DEREF(inductionVar));
1972  sg::linkParentChild(sgnode, direction, &SgForStatement::set_increment);
1973 
1974  // test is not strictly necessary; added for convenience
1975  SgStatement& test = mkForLoopTest(SG_DEREF(inductionVar));
1976  sg::linkParentChild(sgnode, test, &SgForStatement::set_test);
1977 
1978  PragmaContainer pendingPragmas;
1979  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
1980 
1981  // loop body
1982  {
1983  ElemIdRange loopStmts = idRange(stmt.Loop_Statements);
1984 
1985  recordNode(pragmaCtx.labelsAndLoops().asisLoops(), elem.ID, sgnode);
1986  traverseIDs(loopStmts, elemMap(), StmtCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(block)});
1987  }
1988 
1989  processAndPlacePragmas(stmt.Pragmas, { &block }, pragmaCtx); // pragmaCtx.scope(block) ?
1990 
1991  /* unused fields:
1992  Element_ID Corresponding_End_Name;
1993  */
1994  assocstmt = &sgnode;
1995  break;
1996  }
1997 
1998  case A_Block_Statement: // 5.6
1999  {
2000  logKind("A_Block_Statement", elem.ID);
2001 
2002  SgBasicBlock& sgnode = mkBasicBlock();
2003 
2004  recordNode(asisBlocks(), elem.ID, sgnode);
2005  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx, stmt.Statement_Identifier);
2006 
2007  completeDeclarationsWithHandledBlock( stmt.Block_Declarative_Items,
2008  stmt.Block_Statements,
2009  stmt.Block_Exception_Handlers,
2010  stmt.Pragmas,
2011  simpleBlockHandler,
2012  simpleExceptionBlockHandler,
2013  sgnode,
2014  false /* same block for declarations and statements */,
2015  ctx
2016  );
2017 
2018  /* unused fields:
2019  Element_ID Corresponding_End_Name;
2020  bool Is_Name_Repeated;
2021  bool Is_Declare_Block;
2022  */
2023  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2024  break;
2025  }
2026 
2027  case An_Exit_Statement: // 5.7
2028  {
2029  logKind("An_Exit_Statement", elem.ID);
2030 
2031  SgStatement& exitedLoop = lookupNode(ctx.labelsAndLoops().asisLoops(), stmt.Corresponding_Loop_Exited);
2032  SgExpression& exitCondition = getExprID_opt(stmt.Exit_Condition, ctx);
2033  const bool loopIsNamed = stmt.Exit_Loop_Name > 0;
2034  SgStatement& sgnode = mkAdaExitStmt(exitedLoop, exitCondition, loopIsNamed);
2035 
2036  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2037  /* unused fields:
2038  */
2039  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2040  break;
2041  }
2042 
2043  case A_Goto_Statement: // 5.8
2044  {
2045  logKind("A_Goto_Statement", elem.ID);
2046  SgGotoStatement& sgnode = SG_DEREF( sb::buildGotoStatement() );
2047 
2048  ctx.labelsAndLoops().gotojmp(getLabelRef(stmt.Goto_Label, ctx), sgnode);
2049 
2050  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2051  /* unused fields:
2052  Statement_ID Corresponding_Destination_Statement;
2053  */
2054  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2055  break;
2056  }
2057 
2058 
2059  case An_Entry_Call_Statement: // 9.5.3
2060  case A_Procedure_Call_Statement: // 6.4
2061  {
2062  logKind(stmt.Statement_Kind == An_Entry_Call_Statement ? "An_Entry_Call_Statement" : "A_Procedure_Call_Statement", elem.ID);
2063 
2064  //~ if (stmt.Statement_Kind == A_Procedure_Call_Statement)
2065  //~ logTrace() << "A_Procedure_Call_Statement: "
2066  //~ << stmt.Is_Prefix_Notation << " (Is_Prefix_Notation)"
2067  //~ << std::endl;
2068 
2069  ElemIdRange args = idRange(stmt.Call_Statement_Parameters);
2070  // oocall indicates if code uses object-oriented syntax: x.init instead of init(x)
2071  const bool oocall = (stmt.Statement_Kind == A_Procedure_Call_Statement) && stmt.Is_Prefix_Notation;
2072  SgExpression& call = createCall(stmt.Called_Name, args, true /* prefix call */, oocall, ctx);
2073  SgExprStatement& sgnode = SG_DEREF(sb::buildExprStatement(&call));
2074 
2075  attachSourceLocation(call, elem, ctx);
2076  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2077  /* unused fields:
2078  + for A_Procedure_Call_Statement / An_Entry_Call_Statement
2079  Declaration Corresponding_Called_Entity_Unwound
2080 
2081  + for A_Procedure_Call_Statement
2082  bool Is_Dispatching_Call
2083  bool Is_Call_On_Dispatching_Operation
2084  break;
2085  */
2086  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2087  break;
2088  }
2089 
2090  case A_Return_Statement: // 6.5
2091  {
2092  logKind("A_Return_Statement", elem.ID);
2093  Element_Struct* exprel = retrieveElemOpt(elemMap(), stmt.Return_Expression);
2094  SgExpression* retval = exprel ? &getExpr(*exprel, ctx) : nullptr;
2095  SgReturnStmt& sgnode = mkReturnStmt(retval);
2096 
2097  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2098  /* unused fields:
2099  */
2100  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2101  break;
2102  }
2103 
2104 
2105  case An_Accept_Statement: // 9.5.2
2106  {
2107  logKind("An_Accept_Statement", elem.ID);
2108  SgExpression& entryref = getExprID(stmt.Accept_Entry_Direct_Name, ctx);
2109  SgExpression& idx = getExprID_opt(stmt.Accept_Entry_Index, ctx);
2110  SgAdaAcceptStmt& sgnode = mkAdaAcceptStmt(entryref, idx);
2111 
2112  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2113 
2114  ElemIdRange params = idRange(stmt.Accept_Parameters);
2115  SgFunctionParameterList& paramlst = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_parameterList());
2116  AstContext parmctx = ctx.scope(SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_parameterScope()));
2117 
2118  traverseIDs(params, elemMap(), ParmlistCreator{paramlst, {}, parmctx});
2119 
2120  ElemIdRange stmts = idRange(stmt.Accept_Body_Statements);
2121 
2122  if (stmts.empty())
2123  {
2124  SgStatement& noblock = mkNullStatement();
2125 
2126  sg::linkParentChild(sgnode, noblock, &SgAdaAcceptStmt::set_body);
2127  }
2128  else
2129  {
2130  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
2131 
2132  sg::linkParentChild(sgnode, as<SgStatement>(block), &SgAdaAcceptStmt::set_body);
2133 
2134  completeHandledBlock( stmt.Accept_Body_Statements,
2135  stmt.Accept_Body_Exception_Handlers,
2136  stmt.Pragmas,
2137  simpleBlockHandler,
2138  simpleExceptionBlockHandler,
2139  block,
2140  false /* no separate block is needed */,
2141  ctx
2142  );
2143  }
2144 
2145  /* unused fields:
2146  Element_ID Corresponding_End_Name;
2147  bool Is_Name_Repeated;
2148  Declaration_ID Corresponding_Entry;
2149  */
2150  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2151  break;
2152  }
2153 
2154  case A_Requeue_Statement: // 9.5.4
2155  case A_Requeue_Statement_With_Abort: // 9.5.4
2156  {
2157  const bool withAbort = stmt.Statement_Kind == A_Requeue_Statement_With_Abort;
2158 
2159  logKind(withAbort ? "A_Requeue_Statement_With_Abort" : "A_Requeue_Statement", elem.ID);
2160 
2161  SgExpression& expr = getExprID(stmt.Requeue_Entry_Name, ctx);
2162  SgProcessControlStatement& sgnode = mkRequeueStmt(expr, withAbort);
2163 
2164  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2165 
2166  /* unused fields:
2167  Pragma_Element_ID_List Pragmas;
2168  */
2169  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2170  break;
2171  }
2172 
2173  case A_Delay_Until_Statement: // 9.6
2174  case A_Delay_Relative_Statement: // 9.6
2175  {
2176  logKind(stmt.Statement_Kind == A_Delay_Until_Statement ? "A_Delay_Until_Statement" : "A_Delay_Relative_Statement", elem.ID);
2177 
2178  SgExpression& delayexpr = getExprID(stmt.Delay_Expression, ctx);
2179  SgAdaDelayStmt& sgnode = mkAdaDelayStmt(delayexpr, stmt.Statement_Kind != A_Delay_Until_Statement);
2180 
2181  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2182 
2183  /* unused fields:
2184  Pragma_Element_ID_List Pragmas;
2185  */
2186  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2187  break;
2188  }
2189 
2190  case A_Raise_Statement: // 11.3
2191  {
2192  logKind("A_Raise_Statement", elem.ID);
2193  SgExpression& raised = getExprID_opt(stmt.Raised_Exception, ctx);
2194  SgExpression* msg = stmt.Associated_Message ? &getExprID(stmt.Associated_Message, ctx)
2195  : nullptr;
2196  SgStatement& sgnode = mkRaiseStmt(raised, msg);
2197 
2198  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2199  /* unused fields:
2200  Expression_ID Associated_Message;
2201  */
2202  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2203  break;
2204  }
2205  case A_Selective_Accept_Statement: // 9.7.1
2206  {
2207  logKind("A_Selective_Accept_Statement", elem.ID);

2209  SgAdaSelectStmt& sgnode = mkAdaSelectStmt(SgAdaSelectStmt::e_selective_accept);
2210 
2211  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);

2213  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2214  break;
2215  }
2216  case A_Timed_Entry_Call_Statement: // 9.7.2
2217  {
2218  logKind("A_Timed_Entry_Call_Statement", elem.ID);
2219  ElemIdRange range = idRange(stmt.Statement_Paths);
2220  SgAdaSelectStmt& sgnode = mkAdaSelectStmt(SgAdaSelectStmt::e_timed_entry);
2221 
2222  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2223  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), SelectStmtCreator{sgnode, ctx});
2224  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2225  break;
2226  }
2227  case A_Conditional_Entry_Call_Statement: // 9.7.3
2228  {
2229  logKind("A_Conditional_Entry_Call_Statement", elem.ID);
2230  ElemIdRange range = idRange(stmt.Statement_Paths);
2231  SgAdaSelectStmt& sgnode = mkAdaSelectStmt(SgAdaSelectStmt::e_conditional_entry);
2232 
2233  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2234  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), SelectStmtCreator{sgnode, ctx});
2235  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2236  break;
2237  }
2238  case An_Asynchronous_Select_Statement: // 9.7.4
2239  {
2240  logKind("An_Asynchronous_Select_Statement", elem.ID);
2241  ElemIdRange range = idRange(stmt.Statement_Paths);
2242  SgAdaSelectStmt& sgnode = mkAdaSelectStmt(SgAdaSelectStmt::e_asynchronous);
2243 
2244  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2245  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), SelectStmtCreator{sgnode, ctx});
2246  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2247  break;
2248  }
2249  case An_Abort_Statement: // 9.8
2250  {
2251  logKind("An_Abort_Statement", elem.ID);

2253  ElemIdRange range = idRange(stmt.Aborted_Tasks);
2254  std::vector<SgExpression*> aborted = traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), ExprSeqCreator{ctx});
2255  SgExprListExp& abortList = mkExprListExp(aborted);
2256  SgProcessControlStatement& sgnode = mkAbortStmt(abortList);
2257 
2258  ADA_ASSERT (abortList.get_parent());
2259  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2260 
2261  /* unused fields:
2262  */
2263  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2264  break;
2265  }
2266  case A_Terminate_Alternative_Statement: // 9.7.1
2267  {
2268  logKind("A_Terminate_Alternative_Statement", elem.ID);
2269 
2270  SgAdaTerminateStmt& sgnode = mkTerminateStmt();
2271 
2272  completeStmt(sgnode, elem, ctx);
2273  /* unused fields:
2274  */
2275  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2276  break;
2277  }
2278 
2279  case A_Code_Statement: // 13.8 assembly
2280  {
2281  logKind("A_Code_Statement");

2283  // LOOKING FOR an example of a code statement in Asis
2284  ADA_ASSERT(!FAIL_ON_ERROR(ctx));

2286  }
2287 
2288 
2289  case Not_A_Statement: /* break; */ // An unexpected element
2290  //|A2005 start
2291  case An_Extended_Return_Statement: // 6.5

2293  default:

2322  void handleExceptionHandler(Element_Struct& elem, SgTryStmt& tryStmt, AstContext ctx)
2323  {
2324  using PragmaContainer = AstContext::PragmaContainer;
2325  using name_container = NameCreator::result_container ;
2326 
2327  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == An_Exception_Handler);
2328 
2329  logKind("An_Exception_Handler", elem.ID);
2330  Exception_Handler_Struct& ex = elem.The_Union.Exception_Handler;
2331  name_container names = queryDeclNames(ex.Choice_Parameter_Specification, ctx);
2332 
2333  if (names.size() == 0)
2334  {
2335  // add an unnamed exception handler
2336  names.emplace_back(std::string{}, std::string{}, ctx.scope(), elem);
2337  }
2338 
2339  ADA_ASSERT (names.size() == 1);
2340  ElemIdRange tyRange = idRange(ex.Exception_Choices);
2341  SgType& extypes = traverseIDs(tyRange, elemMap(), ExHandlerTypeCreator{ctx});
2342  SgInitializedNamePtrList lst = constructInitializedNamePtrList(ctx, asisVars(), names, extypes, nullptr);
2343  SgBasicBlock& body = mkBasicBlock();
2344 
2345  ADA_ASSERT (lst.size() == 1);
2346  SgCatchOptionStmt& sgnode = mkExceptionHandler(SG_DEREF(lst[0]), body, tryStmt);
2347  ElemIdRange range = idRange(ex.Handler_Statements);
2348 
2349  sg::linkParentChild(tryStmt, as<SgStatement>(sgnode), &SgTryStmt::append_catch_statement);
2350  sgnode.set_trystmt(&tryStmt);
2351  sgnode.set_parent(tryStmt.get_catch_statement_seq_root());
2352 
2353  PragmaContainer pendingPragmas;
2354  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
2355 
2356  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), StmtCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(body)});
2357 
2358  computeSourceRangeFromChildren(body);
2359  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, pragmaCtx);
2360  processAndPlacePragmas(ex.Pragmas, { &body }, pragmaCtx); // pragmaCtx.scope(body) ?
2361  /* unused fields:
2362  */
2363  }

2441  [[noreturn]]
2442  bool fatalError(const Expression_Struct& expr, const NameData& nm)
2443  {
2444  logFatal() << "using unknown package/type: "
2445  << "'" << nm.fullName << "': "
2446  << expr.Corresponding_Name_Definition << " / " << expr.Corresponding_Name_Declaration
2447  << "\n in scope type: " << typeid(ctx.scope()).name()
2448  << std::endl;
2449

2453  void operator()(Element_Struct& el)
2454  {
2455  ADA_ASSERT (el.Element_Kind == An_Expression);
2456 
2457  NameData usedEl = getName(el, ctx); // either unit or type
2458  Expression_Struct& expr = asisExpression(usedEl.elem());
2459  SgDeclarationStatement* used = nullptr;
2460 
2461  (used != nullptr)
2462  || (used = findFirst(m, expr.Corresponding_Name_Definition, expr.Corresponding_Name_Declaration))
2463  || (used = fromSymbolLookup(usedEl))
2464  || (used = findFirst(adaPkgs(), usedEl.fullName)) // fullname or ident?
2465  || (used = typeDeclarationFromStandard(usedEl))
2466  || (fatalError(expr, usedEl))
2467  ;
2468 
2469  SgUsingDeclarationStatement& sgnode = mkUseClause(*used);
2470  AdaIdentifier fullName{usedEl.fullName};
2471  std::size_t attrPos = fullName.find("'");
2472 
2473  if (attrPos != std::string::npos)
2474  {
2475  ADA_ASSERT(fullName.size() > attrPos);
2476  // \todo introduce proper flag
2477  sgnode.set_adaTypeAttribute(fullName.substr(attrPos+1));
2478  }
2479 
2480  recordNode(asisDecls(), el.ID, sgnode);
2481  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, el, ctx);
2482  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
2483  }
2484 
2485  private:
2486  map_t<int, SgDeclarationStatement*>& m;
2487  AstContext ctx;
2488 
2489  UseClauseCreator() = delete;
2490  };

2598 
2599  bool queryIfDerivedFromEnum(Element_Struct& elem, AstContext ctx)
2600  {
2601  if (elem.Element_Kind == A_Definition)
2602  {
2603  logKind("qid: A_Definition", elem.ID);
2604 
2605  Definition_Struct& def = elem.The_Union.Definition;
2606 
2607  if (def.Definition_Kind == A_Subtype_Indication)
2608  {
2609  Subtype_Indication_Struct& subtype = def.The_Union.The_Subtype_Indication;
2610 
2611  return queryIfDerivedFromEnumID(subtype.Subtype_Mark, ctx);
2612  }
2613 
2614  if (def.Definition_Kind == A_Formal_Type_Definition)
2615  {
2616  // \todo could this require enum handling?
2617  logInfo() << "qid: definition-kind: A_Formal_Type_Definition"
2618  << std::endl;
2619  return false;
2620  }
2621 
2622  if (def.Definition_Kind != A_Type_Definition)
2623  {
2624  logWarn() << "qid: unexpected definition-kind: " << def.Definition_Kind
2625  << std::endl;
2626  return false;
2627  }
2628 
2629  Type_Definition_Struct& tydef = def.The_Union.The_Type_Definition;
2630 
2631  return ( (tydef.Type_Kind == An_Enumeration_Type_Definition)
2632  || ( (tydef.Type_Kind == A_Derived_Type_Definition)
2633  && queryIfDerivedFromEnumID(tydef.Parent_Subtype_Indication, ctx)
2634  )
2635  );
2636  }
2637 
2638  if (elem.Element_Kind == An_Expression)
2639  {
2640  logKind("qid: An_Expression", elem.ID);
2641  Expression_Struct& expr = elem.The_Union.Expression;
2642 
2643  if (expr.Expression_Kind == A_Selected_Component)
2644  {
2645  // \todo consider checking for Standard prefix..
2646  return queryIfDerivedFromEnumID(expr.Selector, ctx);
2647  }
2648 
2649  return ( (expr.Expression_Kind == An_Identifier)
2650  && queryIfDerivedFromEnumID( expr.Corresponding_Name_Declaration,
2651  ctx,
2652  [tyName = AdaIdentifier{expr.Name_Image}](AstContext) -> bool
2653  {
2654  return isSgEnumType(adaTypes().at(tyName));
2655  }
2656  )
2657  );
2658  }
2659 
2660  if (elem.Element_Kind == A_Declaration)
2661  {
2662  logKind("qid: A_Declaration", elem.ID);
2663  Declaration_Struct& decl = elem.The_Union.Declaration;
2664 
2665  if ( (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Task_Type_Declaration)
2666  || (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Protected_Type_Declaration)
2667  || (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Private_Extension_Declaration)
2668  )
2669  return false;
2670 
2671  if ( (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Private_Type_Declaration)
2672  || (decl.Declaration_Kind == An_Incomplete_Type_Declaration)
2673  )
2674  return queryIfDerivedFromEnumID(decl.Corresponding_Type_Completion, ctx);
2675 
2676  ADA_ASSERT( (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Subtype_Declaration)
2677  || (decl.Declaration_Kind == An_Ordinary_Type_Declaration)
2678  || (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Formal_Type_Declaration)
2679  );
2680 
2681  return queryIfDerivedFromEnumID(decl.Type_Declaration_View, ctx);
2682  }
2683 
2684  logError() << "unhandled element kind [queryIfDerivedFromEnum]: " << elem.Element_Kind
2685  << std::endl;
2686  return false;
2687  }
2688 
2689  bool queryIfDerivedFromEnumID(Element_ID id, AstContext ctx, std::function<bool(AstContext)> fallback)
2690  {
2691  Element_Struct* el = retrieveElemOpt(elemMap(), id);
2692 
2693  return el ? queryIfDerivedFromEnum(*el, ctx) : fallback(ctx);
2694  }

2697  queryDefinitionDetails(Element_Struct& complElem, AstContext ctx);

2699  Type_Kinds
2700  queryBaseDefinitionData(Definition_Struct& typeDefn, Type_Kinds tyKind, Element_ID /*currID*/, AstContext ctx)
2701  {
2702  ADA_ASSERT (tyKind == A_Derived_Type_Definition);
2703 
2704  if (queryIfDerivedFromEnumID(typeDefn.The_Union.The_Type_Definition.Parent_Subtype_Indication, ctx))
2705  {
2706  tyKind = An_Enumeration_Type_Definition;
2707  }
2708 
2709  return tyKind;

2712  DefinitionDetails
2713  queryDefinitionDetails(Element_Struct& complElem, AstContext ctx)
2714  {
2715  ADA_ASSERT (complElem.Element_Kind == A_Declaration);
2716 
2717  Declaration_Struct& complDecl = complElem.The_Union.Declaration;
2718  NameData declname = singleName(complDecl, ctx);
2719 
2720  if (complDecl.Declaration_Kind == A_Task_Type_Declaration)
2721  {
2722  logKind("A_Task_Type_Declaration", complElem.ID);
2723 
2724  return DefinitionDetails{declname.id(), A_Task_Type_Declaration, Not_A_Type_Definition};
2725  }
2726 
2727  if (complDecl.Declaration_Kind == A_Protected_Type_Declaration)
2728  {
2729  logKind("A_Protected_Type_Declaration", complElem.ID);
2730 
2731  return DefinitionDetails{declname.id(), A_Protected_Type_Declaration, Not_A_Type_Definition};
2732  }
2733 
2734  if (complDecl.Declaration_Kind == An_Ordinary_Type_Declaration)
2735  logKind("An_Ordinary_Type_Declaration", complElem.ID);
2736  else if (complDecl.Declaration_Kind == A_Formal_Type_Declaration)
2737  logKind("A_Formal_Type_Declaration", complElem.ID);
2738  else if (complDecl.Declaration_Kind == A_Subtype_Declaration)
2739  logKind("A_Subtype_Declaration", complElem.ID);
2740  else
2741  {
2742  logFlaw() << "unexpected decl kind [queryDefinitionData]: " << complDecl.Declaration_Kind
2743  << std::endl;
2744  }
2745 
2746  Element_Struct& typeElem = retrieveElem(elemMap(), complDecl.Type_Declaration_View);
2747  ADA_ASSERT (typeElem.Element_Kind == A_Definition);
2748 
2749  Definition_Struct& typeDefn = typeElem.The_Union.Definition;
2750 
2751  // \todo
2752  // this is questionable, but how shall we deal with non-plain type definitions ..?
2753  Type_Kinds resKind = A_Derived_Type_Definition;
2754 
2755  switch (typeDefn.Definition_Kind)
2756  {
2757  case A_Type_Definition:
2758  {
2759  resKind = typeDefn.The_Union.The_Type_Definition.Type_Kind;
2760 
2761  // look at the base of a derived type
2762  if (resKind == A_Derived_Type_Definition)
2763  resKind = queryBaseDefinitionData(typeDefn, resKind, complElem.ID, ctx);
2764 
2765  break;
2766  }
2767 
2768  case A_Formal_Type_Definition:
2769  break;
2770 
2771  default:
2772  logFatal() << "unexpected def kind [queryDefinitionData]: " << typeDefn.Definition_Kind
2773  << std::endl;
2774  ADA_ASSERT(false);
2775  }
2776 
2777  return DefinitionDetails{declname.id(), complDecl.Declaration_Kind, resKind};
2778  }
2779 
2780  // find the element and type kind of the corresponding complete declaration
2781  DefinitionDetails
2782  queryDefinitionDetailsID(Element_ID completeElementId, AstContext ctx)
2783  {
2784  Element_Struct& complElem = retrieveElem(elemMap(), completeElementId);
2785 
2786  return queryDefinitionDetails(complElem, ctx);
2787  }

2790  // In Asis forward declarations are represented as anonymous types.
2791  // In ROSE forward declarations are represented with the same AST node type.
2792  // (e.g., a class is forward declared as a class not as typedef).
2793  // In order to create the right ROSE AST node, the actual information of
2794  // the type in Asis is needed.
2795  // This methods looks at the actual declared element and returns the
2796  // corresponding details.
2797  // e.g.,
2798  // type T1; -- This should become a first nondefining declaration in ROSE.
2799  // -- To create the proper AST node, we need to know what
2800  // -- T1 will be (in this case a task type).
2801  // task type T1 ...;
2802  DefinitionDetails
2803  queryDeclarationDetails(Declaration_Struct& decl, AstContext ctx)
2804  {
2805  //~ return queryDefinitionDetailsID(decl.Corresponding_Type_Completion, ctx);
2806  return queryDefinitionDetailsID(decl.Corresponding_Type_Declaration, ctx);
2807  }

2824  void

2828  {
2829  case A_Private_Type_Definition:

2860  struct InheritedSymbolCreator
2861  {
2862  InheritedSymbolCreator(SgNamedType& sourceRootType, SgNamedType& dervType, AstContext astctx)
2863  : baseType(sourceRootType), dervivedType(dervType), ctx(astctx)
2864  {}
2865 
2866  void operator()(Element_Struct& elem)
2867  {
2868  SgDeclarationStatement* fndcl = findFirst(asisDecls(), elem.ID);
2869  SgFunctionDeclaration* fn = isSgFunctionDeclaration(fndcl);
2870 
2871  if (fn == nullptr)
2872  {
2873  logFlaw() << "unable to find function with Asis element ID " << elem.ID << std::endl;
2874  return;
2875  }
2876 
2877  SgFunctionSymbol* fnsym = findFirst(inheritedSymbols(), std::make_pair(fn, &baseType));
2878  if (fnsym == nullptr) fnsym = isSgFunctionSymbol(fn->search_for_symbol_from_symbol_table());
2879 
2880  if (fnsym == nullptr)
2881  {
2882  logFlaw() << "unable to find (derived) function symbol for " << fn->get_name() << std::endl;
2883  return;
2884  }
2885 
2886  SgDeclarationStatement const* symdcl = fnsym->get_declaration();
2887  if (symdcl && (symdcl->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration() != fn->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration()))
2888  {
2889  logFlaw() << fn->get_name() << " sym/dcl mismatch"
2890  << std::endl;
2891  }
2892 
2893 
2894  SgAdaInheritedFunctionSymbol& sgnode = mkAdaInheritedFunctionSymbol(*fnsym, dervivedType, ctx.scope());
2895  const auto inserted = inheritedSymbols().insert(std::make_pair(InheritedSymbolKey{fn, &dervivedType}, &sgnode));
2896 
2897  ROSE_ASSERT(inserted.second);
2898  }
2899 
2900  private:
2901  SgNamedType& baseType;
2902  SgNamedType& dervivedType;
2903  AstContext ctx;
2904  };

2906  struct InheritedEnumeratorCreator
2907  {
2908  InheritedEnumeratorCreator(SgEnumDeclaration& enumDcl, SgEnumDeclaration& /*orig*/, AstContext astctx)
2909  : derivedDcl(enumDcl), ctx(astctx)
2910  {}
2911 
2912  // assuming that the inherited enumerators appear in the same order
2913  void operator()(Element_ID id)
2914  {
2915  // PP (01/25/22) new code: the old code tried to link the enumerators to their original definition
2916  // by setting the initializer to the old value. However, derived enumerators can have
2917  // different representation values, and to support JACCEL-265 and the translation to C++
2918  // in general, the link to the original declaration is no longer maintained.
2919  // Instead, the initializer now links to the representation value. The relationship to the
2920  // inherited values is now implied.
2921  // \todo The code is most similar to the normal EnumeratorCreator in AdaType.C and
2922  // could be refactored to eliminate code duplication.
2923  SgType& enumTy = SG_DEREF(derivedDcl.get_type());
2924  Element_Struct& elem = retrieveElem(elemMap(), id);
2925  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == A_Declaration);
2926  logKind("A_Declaration", id);
2927 
2928  Declaration_Struct& decl = elem.The_Union.Declaration;
2929  ADA_ASSERT (decl.Declaration_Kind == An_Enumeration_Literal_Specification);
2930  logKind("An_Enumeration_Literal_Specification (inherited)", id);
2931 
2932  NameData name = singleName(decl, ctx);
2933  ADA_ASSERT (name.ident == name.fullName);
2934 
2935  // \todo name.ident could be a character literal, such as 'c'
2936  // since SgEnumDeclaration only accepts SgInitializedName as enumerators
2937  // SgInitializedName are created with the name 'c' instead of character constants.
2938  SgExpression& repval = getEnumRepresentationValue(name.elem(), ctx);
2939  SgInitializedName& sgnode = mkInitializedName(name.ident, enumTy, &repval);
2940 
2941  sgnode.set_scope(derivedDcl.get_scope());
2942  //~ sg::linkParentChild(enumdcl, sgnode, &SgEnumDeclaration::append_enumerator);
2943  derivedDcl.append_enumerator(&sgnode);
2944  ADA_ASSERT (sgnode.get_parent() == &derivedDcl);
2945 
2946  recordNode(asisVars(), name.id(), sgnode);
2947  }
2948 
2949  private:
2950  SgEnumDeclaration& derivedDcl;
2951  AstContext ctx;
2952  };

2987  std::tuple<SgEnumDeclaration*, SgAdaRangeConstraint*>
2988  getBaseEnum(SgType* baseTy)
2989  {
2990  ADA_ASSERT(baseTy);
2991 
2992  SgAdaRangeConstraint* constraint = nullptr;
2993  SgEnumDeclaration* basedecl = nullptr;
2994 
2995  if (SgAdaDerivedType* deriveTy = isSgAdaDerivedType(baseTy))
2996  {
2997  SgType* ty = deriveTy->get_base_type();
2998 
2999  if (SgAdaSubtype* subTy = isSgAdaSubtype(ty))
3000  {
3001  ty = subTy->get_base_type();
3002  constraint = isSgAdaRangeConstraint(subTy->get_constraint());
3003  }
3004 
3005  basedecl = si::Ada::baseEnumDeclaration(ty);
3006  }
3007 
3008  if (basedecl == nullptr)
3009  {
3010  logFlaw() << "basedecl == nullptr: " << typeid(*baseTy).name() << std::endl;
3011  ASSERT_not_null(basedecl);
3012  }
3013 
3014  if (SgEnumDeclaration* realdecl = isSgEnumDeclaration(basedecl->get_definingDeclaration()))
3015  basedecl = realdecl;
3016 
3017  return { basedecl, constraint };
3018  }

3020  void
3021  processInheritedEnumValues( Type_Definition_Struct& tydef,
3022  SgEnumDeclaration& derivedTypeDcl,
3023  AstContext ctx
3024  )
3025  {
3026  {
3027  ElemIdRange range = idRange(tydef.Implicit_Inherited_Subprograms);
3028  SgEnumType& derivedType = SG_DEREF(derivedTypeDcl.get_type());
3029  SgType* baseType = si::Ada::baseType(derivedType);
3030  SgNamedType* baseRootType = isSgNamedType(si::Ada::typeRoot(baseType).typerep());
3031 
3032  if (baseRootType == nullptr)
3033  {
3034  logFlaw() << "unable to find base-root for enum " << derivedType.get_name()
3035  << " / base = " << baseType
3036  << std::endl;
3037  return;
3038  }
3039 
3040  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), InheritedSymbolCreator{*baseRootType, derivedType, ctx});
3041  }
3042 
3043  {
3044  using BaseTuple = std::tuple<SgEnumDeclaration*, SgAdaRangeConstraint*>;
3045 
3046  BaseTuple baseInfo = getBaseEnum(derivedTypeDcl.get_adaParentType());
3047  SgEnumDeclaration& origDecl = SG_DEREF(std::get<0>(baseInfo));
3048 
3049  // do not process derivations from Standard.*Char type.
3050  // the reason is that the derived enums will have its symbols
3051  // injected into the new scope as alias symbols, but for
3052  // character based enums, the symbols are not physically present.
3053  if ( si::Ada::characterBaseType(origDecl.get_type()) )
3054  return;
3055 
3056  ElemIdRange range = idRange(tydef.Implicit_Inherited_Declarations);
3057 
3058  // just traverse the IDs, as the elements are not present
3059  std::for_each(range.first, range.second, InheritedEnumeratorCreator{derivedTypeDcl, origDecl, ctx});
3060  }
3061  }

3063  void
3064  processInheritedElementsOfDerivedTypes(TypeData& ty, SgDeclarationStatement& dcl, AstContext ctx)
3065  {
3066  Type_Definition_Struct& tydef = ty.definitionStruct();
3067 
3068  if ( (tydef.Type_Kind != A_Derived_Type_Definition)
3069  && (tydef.Type_Kind != A_Derived_Record_Extension_Definition)
3070  )
3071  {
3072  return;
3073  }
3074 
3075  if (SgTypedefDeclaration* derivedTypeDcl = isSgTypedefDeclaration(&dcl))
3076  processInheritedSubroutines(tydef, *derivedTypeDcl, ctx);
3077  else if (SgClassDeclaration* classTypeDcl = isSgClassDeclaration(&dcl))
3078  processInheritedSubroutines(tydef, *classTypeDcl, ctx);
3079  else if (SgEnumDeclaration* derivedEnumDcl = isSgEnumDeclaration(&dcl))
3080  processInheritedEnumValues(tydef, *derivedEnumDcl, ctx);
3081  else if (SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl* discrTypeDcl = isSgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl(&dcl))
3082  processInheritedSubroutines(tydef, *discrTypeDcl, ctx);
3083  else
3084  ADA_ASSERT(false);
3085  }

3088  SgDeclarationStatement&
3089  createOpaqueDecl(NameData adaname, Declaration_Struct& decl, const DefinitionDetails detail, AstContext ctx)
3090  {
3091  SgScopeStatement& scope = ctx.scope();
3092  Element_Struct* typeview = nullptr;
3093  SgDeclarationStatement* res = nullptr;
3094 
3095  if (!isInvalidId(decl.Type_Declaration_View))
3096  {
3097  typeview = &retrieveElem(elemMap(), decl.Type_Declaration_View);
3098  ADA_ASSERT (typeview->Element_Kind == A_Definition);
3099  }
3100 
3101  if (detail.declKind() == A_Task_Type_Declaration)
3102  res = &mkAdaTaskTypeDecl(adaname.ident, nullptr /* no spec */, scope);
3103  else if (detail.declKind() == A_Protected_Type_Declaration)
3104  res = &mkAdaProtectedTypeDecl(adaname.ident, nullptr /* no spec */, scope);
3105  else
3106  {
3107  switch (detail.typeKind())
3108  {
3109  case A_Derived_Type_Definition:
3110  case A_Signed_Integer_Type_Definition:
3111  case A_Modular_Type_Definition:
3112  case A_Floating_Point_Definition:
3113  case A_Decimal_Fixed_Point_Definition:
3114  case An_Access_Type_Definition:
3115  case An_Ordinary_Fixed_Point_Definition:// \todo untested
3116  case An_Unconstrained_Array_Definition: // \todo untested
3117  case A_Constrained_Array_Definition: // \todo untested
3118  {
3119  res = &mkTypeDecl(adaname.ident, mkOpaqueType(), scope);
3120  break;
3121  }
3122 
3123  case An_Enumeration_Type_Definition:
3124  {
3125  res = &mkEnumDecl(adaname.ident, scope);
3126  break;
3127  }
3128 
3129  case A_Record_Type_Definition:
3130  case A_Derived_Record_Extension_Definition:
3131  case A_Tagged_Record_Type_Definition:
3132  {
3133  SgClassDeclaration& sgnode = mkRecordDecl(adaname.ident, scope);
3134 
3135  if (typeview)
3136  setParentRecordConstraintIfAvail(sgnode, typeview->The_Union.Definition, ctx);
3137 
3138  res = &sgnode;
3139  break;
3140  }
3141 
3142  default:
3143  logWarn() << "unhandled opaque type declaration: " << detail.typeKind()
3144  << std::endl;
3145  ADA_ASSERT (!FAIL_ON_ERROR(ctx));
3146  res = &mkTypeDecl(adaname.ident, mkOpaqueType(), scope);
3147  }
3148  }
3149 
3150  // \todo put declaration tags on
3151  SgDeclarationStatement& resdcl = SG_DEREF(res);
3152 
3153  if (typeview)
3154  setTypeModifiers(resdcl, typeview->The_Union.Definition, ctx);
3155  else if (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Tagged_Incomplete_Type_Declaration)
3156  setModifiers(resdcl, false /*abstract*/, false /*limited*/, true /*tagged*/);
3157 
3158  return resdcl;
3159  }

3282  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl&
3283  createDiscriminatedDeclID( Element_Struct& elem,
3284  Element_Struct* secondary,
3285  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl* nondefOpt,
3286  AstContext ctx
3287  )
3288  {
3289  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == A_Definition);
3290  logKind("A_Definition", elem.ID);
3291 
3292  // many definitions are handled else where
3293  // here we want to convert the rest that can appear in declarative context
3294 
3295  SgScopeStatement& scope = ctx.scope();
3296  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl& sgnode = mkAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl(scope, nondefOpt);
3297  Definition_Struct& def = elem.The_Union.Definition;
3298 
3299  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
3300 
3301  if (def.Definition_Kind == A_Known_Discriminant_Part)
3302  {
3303  logKind("A_Known_Discriminant_Part", elem.ID);
3304 
3305  SgScopeStatement& scope = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_discriminantScope());
3306  ElemIdRange discriminants = idRange(def.The_Union.The_Known_Discriminant_Part.Discriminants);
3307  ElemIdRange secondaryIDs = secondaryKnownDiscrimnants(secondary, ctx);
3308  std::vector<Element_ID> secondaries = reverseElems(flattenNameLists(secondaryIDs, ctx));
3309 
3310  traverseIDs(discriminants, elemMap(), DiscriminantCreator{sgnode, std::move(secondaries), ctx.scope(scope)});
3311  }
3312  else
3313  {
3314  ADA_ASSERT (def.Definition_Kind == An_Unknown_Discriminant_Part);
3315 
3316  logKind("An_Unknown_Discriminant_Part", elem.ID);
3317  }
3318 
3319  return sgnode;
3320  }

3323  // handles incomplete (but completed) and private types
3324  SgDeclarationStatement&
3325  handleOpaqueTypes( Element_Struct& elem,
3326  Declaration_Struct& decl,
3327  bool isPrivate,
3328  AstContext ctx
3329  )
3330  {
3331  logTrace() << "\n abstract: " << decl.Has_Abstract
3332  << "\n limited: " << decl.Has_Limited
3333  << "\n private: " << decl.Has_Private
3334  << std::endl;
3335 
3336  NameData adaname = singleName(decl, ctx);
3337  ADA_ASSERT (adaname.fullName == adaname.ident);
3338 
3339 #if DEBUG_RECURSION
3340  try // for debug purposes
3341  {
3342 #endif /* DEBUG_RECURSION */
3343  DefinitionDetails defdata = queryDeclarationDetails(decl, ctx);
3344  SgScopeStatement* parentScope = &ctx.scope();
3345  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl* discr = createDiscriminatedDeclID_opt( decl.Discriminant_Part,
3346  0,
3347  nullptr,
3348  ctx
3349  );
3350 
3351  if (discr)
3352  {
3353  parentScope = discr->get_discriminantScope();
3354  }
3355 
3356  SgScopeStatement& scope = SG_DEREF(parentScope);
3357  Element_ID id = adaname.id();
3358  SgDeclarationStatement& sgdecl = createOpaqueDecl(adaname, decl, defdata, ctx.scope(scope));
3359  SgDeclarationStatement* assocdecl = nullptr;
3360 
3361  attachSourceLocation(sgdecl, elem, ctx);
3362  privatize(sgdecl, isPrivate);
3363  recordNode(asisTypes(), id, sgdecl);
3364  recordNode(asisTypes(), defdata.id(), sgdecl); // rec @ def
3365 
3366  if (!discr)
3367  {
3368  ADA_ASSERT(&ctx.scope() == parentScope);
3369  ctx.appendStatement(sgdecl);
3370  assocdecl = &sgdecl;
3371  }
3372  else
3373  {
3374  completeDiscriminatedDecl(id, elem, *discr, sgdecl, isPrivate, ctx);
3375  assocdecl = discr;
3376  }
3377 
3378  if (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Private_Extension_Declaration)
3379  {
3380  if (Element_Struct* tyview = retrieveElemOpt(elemMap(), decl.Type_Declaration_View))
3381  {
3382  ADA_ASSERT(tyview->Element_Kind == A_Definition);
3383  Definition_Struct& tydef = tyview->The_Union.Definition;
3384 
3385  if (tydef.Definition_Kind == A_Private_Extension_Definition)
3386  {
3387  SgDeclarationStatement* tydcl = discr ? discr : &sgdecl;
3388 
3389  processInheritedSubroutines( SG_DEREF(si::getDeclaredType(tydcl)),
3390  idRange(tydef.The_Union.The_Private_Extension_Definition.Implicit_Inherited_Subprograms),
3391  idRange(tydef.The_Union.The_Private_Extension_Definition.Implicit_Inherited_Declarations),
3392  ctx
3393  );
3394  }
3395  }
3396  }
3397 #if DEBUG_RECURSION
3398  }
3399  catch (const DbgRecursionError& n)
3400  {
3401  logFlaw() << "root of recursion error: " << adaname.fullName
3402  << "\n declared at: " << elem.Source_Location.Unit_Name
3403  << ":" << elem.Source_Location.First_Line
3404  << ":" << elem.Source_Location.First_Column
3405  << std::endl;
3406  throw;
3407  }
3408 #endif /* DEBUG_RECURSION */
3409 
3410  return SG_DEREF(assocdecl);
3411  }

3413  // returns a function declaration statement for a declaration statement
3414  // checks if the function is an Ada generic function, where the declaration
3415  // is hidden under an SgAdaGenericDecl.
3416  SgFunctionDeclaration* getFunctionDeclaration(SgDeclarationStatement* dcl)
3417  {
3418  // PP: 2/6/22 refactored function out of handleDeclaration
3419  if (SgFunctionDeclaration* fndcl = isSgFunctionDeclaration(dcl))
3420  return fndcl;
3421 
3422  // MS: 7/26/2021 This point may be reached for both regular and
3423  // generic subprograms. If it is a generic subprogram that was
3424  // declared, then we'll need to get the declaration out of the
3425  // SgAdaGenericDecl node.
3426  if (SgAdaGenericDecl* generic = isSgAdaGenericDecl(dcl))
3427  return isSgFunctionDeclaration(generic->get_declaration());
3428 
3429  return nullptr;
3430  }

3432  // retrieves package spec declarations, similar to getFunctionDeclaration
3433  SgAdaPackageSpecDecl* getAdaPackageSpecDecl(SgDeclarationStatement* dcl)
3434  {
3435  if (SgAdaPackageSpecDecl* spcdcl = isSgAdaPackageSpecDecl(dcl))
3436  return spcdcl;
3437 
3438  if (SgAdaGenericDecl* generic = isSgAdaGenericDecl(dcl))
3439  return isSgAdaPackageSpecDecl(generic->get_declaration());
3440 
3441  return nullptr;
3442  }

3553 void handleRepresentationClause(Element_Struct& elem, AstContext ctx)
3554 {
3555  using PragmaContainer = AstContext::PragmaContainer;
3556 
3557  Clause_Struct& clause = elem.The_Union.Clause;
3558  ADA_ASSERT (clause.Clause_Kind == A_Representation_Clause);
3559 
3560  Representation_Clause_Struct& repclause = clause.Representation_Clause;
3561 
3562  switch (repclause.Representation_Clause_Kind)
3563  {
3564  case A_Record_Representation_Clause: // 13.5.1
3565  {
3566  using SageRecordClause = SgAdaRepresentationClause;
3567 
3568  logKind("A_Record_Representation_Clause", elem.ID);
3569 
3570  SgType& tyrec = getDeclTypeID(repclause.Representation_Clause_Name, ctx);
3571  SgExpression& modexp = getExprID_opt(repclause.Mod_Clause_Expression, ctx);
3572  SageRecordClause& sgnode = mkAdaRepresentationClause(tyrec, modexp);
3573  SgBasicBlock& components = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_components());
3574  ElemIdRange range = idRange(repclause.Component_Clauses);
3575 
3576 
3577  // sgnode is not a decl: recordNode(asisDecls(), el.ID, sgnode);
3578  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
3579  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
3580 
3581  PragmaContainer pendingPragmas;
3582  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
3583 
3584  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), ComponentClauseCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(components)});
3585 
3586  processAndPlacePragmas(repclause.Pragmas, { &components }, pragmaCtx.scope(components));
3587  /* unhandled fields:
3588  */
3589  break;
3590  }
3591 
3592  case An_At_Clause: // J.7
3593  {
3594  using SageRecordClause = SgAdaRepresentationClause;
3595 
3596  logKind("An_At_Clause", elem.ID);
3597 
3598  // \todo Representation_Clause_Name may not refer to a type but to a variable
3599  // (e.g.,rep_sys_address.adb)
3600  // consider using expressions as base for AdaRepresentationClause...
3601  SgType& ty = getDeclTypeID(repclause.Representation_Clause_Name, ctx);
3602  SgExpression& modexp = getExprID_opt(repclause.Representation_Clause_Expression, ctx);
3603  SageRecordClause& sgnode = mkAdaRepresentationClause(ty, modexp, true /* at-clause */);
3604 
3605  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
3606  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
3607  /* unhandled fields:
3608  */
3609  break;
3610  }
3611 
3612  case An_Attribute_Definition_Clause: // 13.3
3613  {
3614  logKind("An_Attribute_Definition_Clause", elem.ID);
3615  SgAdaAttributeExp& lenattr = getAttributeExprID(repclause.Representation_Clause_Name, ctx);
3616  SgExpression& lenexpr = getExprID(repclause.Representation_Clause_Expression, ctx);
3617  SgAdaAttributeClause& sgnode = mkAdaAttributeClause(lenattr, lenexpr);
3618 
3619  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
3620  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
3621  /* unhandled fields:
3622  */
3623  break;
3624  }
3625 
3626  case An_Enumeration_Representation_Clause: // 13.4
3627  {
3628  logKind("An_Enumeration_Representation_Clause", elem.ID);
3629  SgType& enumty = getDeclTypeID(repclause.Representation_Clause_Name, ctx);
3630  Element_Struct& inielem = retrieveElem(elemMap(), repclause.Representation_Clause_Expression);
3631  ADA_ASSERT (inielem.Element_Kind == An_Expression);
3632 
3633  Expression_Struct& inilist = inielem.The_Union.Expression;
3634 
3635  ADA_ASSERT( inilist.Expression_Kind == A_Named_Array_Aggregate
3636  || inilist.Expression_Kind == A_Positional_Array_Aggregate
3637  );
3638 
3639  ElemIdRange range = idRange(inilist.Array_Component_Associations);
3640  SgExprListExp& enumvals = traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), EnumValueCreator{ctx});
3641  SgAdaEnumRepresentationClause& sgnode = mkAdaEnumRepresentationClause(enumty, enumvals);
3642 
3643  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
3644  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
3645  /* unhandled fields:
3646  */
3647  break;
3648  }
3649 
3650  case Not_A_Representation_Clause: // An unexpected element
3651  default:
3652  logWarn() << "unhandled representation clause kind: " << repclause.Representation_Clause_Kind << std::endl;
3653  ADA_ASSERT (!FAIL_ON_ERROR(ctx));
3654  }
3655 }

3657 void handleClause(Element_Struct& elem, AstContext ctx)
3658 {
3659  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == A_Clause);
3660  logKind("A_Clause");
3661 
3662  Clause_Struct& clause = elem.The_Union.Clause;
3663 
3664  switch (clause.Clause_Kind)
3665  {
3666  case A_With_Clause: // 10.1.2
3667  {
3668  logKind("A_With_Clause", elem.ID);
3669  ElemIdRange range = idRange(clause.Clause_Names);
3670  SgExpressionPtrList implst = traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), WithListCreator{ctx});
3671  SgImportStatement& sgnode = mkWithClause(std::move(implst));
3672  SgScopeStatement& scope = ctx.scope();
3673 
3674  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
3675  recordNode(asisDecls(), elem.ID, sgnode);
3676  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
3677  ADA_ASSERT (sgnode.get_parent() == &scope);
3678 
3679  // recordNonUniqueNode(asisDecls(), impID, sgnode);
3680 
3681  /* unused fields:
3682  bool Has_Limited
3683  */
3684  break;
3685  }
3686 
3687  case A_Use_Type_Clause: // 8.4
3688  case A_Use_Package_Clause: // 8.4
3689  {
3690  const bool typeClause = (clause.Clause_Kind == A_Use_Type_Clause);
3691 
3692  logKind(typeClause ? "A_Use_Type_Clause" : "A_Use_Package_Clause", elem.ID);
3693 
3694  ElemIdRange range = idRange(clause.Clause_Names);
3695  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), UseClauseCreator{(typeClause ? asisTypes() : asisDecls()), ctx});
3696  /* unused fields:
3697  */
3698  break;
3699  }
3700 
3701  case A_Representation_Clause: // 13.1 -> Representation_Clause_Kinds
3702  {
3703  handleRepresentationClause(elem, ctx);
3704  break;
3705  }
3706 
3707  case A_Component_Clause: // 13.5.1
3708  // handled in ComponentClauseCreator
3709  ADA_ASSERT(false);
3710  break;
3711 
3712  case A_Use_All_Type_Clause: // 8.4: Ada 2012
3713  case Not_A_Clause: /* break; */ // An unexpected element
3714  default:
3715  logWarn() << "unhandled clause kind: " << clause.Clause_Kind << std::endl;
3716  ADA_ASSERT (!FAIL_ON_ERROR(ctx));
3717  }
3718 }

3735 void handleDefinition(Element_Struct& elem, AstContext ctx)
3736 {
3737  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == A_Definition);
3738  logKind("A_Definition", elem.ID);
3739 
3740  // many definitions are handled else where
3741  // here we want to convert the rest that can appear in declarative context
3742 
3743  Definition_Struct& def = elem.The_Union.Definition;
3744 
3745  switch (def.Definition_Kind)
3746  {
3747  case A_Null_Component: // 3.8(4)
3748  {
3749  SgDeclarationStatement& sgnode = mkNullDecl();
3750 
3751  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
3752  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
3753  break;
3754  }
3755 
3756  case A_Variant_Part: // 3.8.1(2)
3757  {
3758  handleVariant(elem, def.The_Union.The_Variant_Part, ctx);
3759  break;
3760  }
3761 
3762  case A_Type_Definition: // 3.2.1(4) -> Type_Kinds
3763  // handled in getTypeFoundation
3764  case A_Subtype_Indication: // 3.2.2(3)
3765  // handled in getDefinitionType
3766  case A_Constraint: // 3.2.2(5) -> Constraint_Kinds
3767  // handled in getRangeConstraint
3768  case A_Component_Definition: // 3.6(7) -> Trait_Kinds
3769  // handled in getDefinitionType
3770  case A_Discrete_Range: // 3.6.1(3) -> Discrete_Range_Kinds
3771  // handled in getDefinitionExpr
3772  case A_Record_Definition: // 3.8(3)
3773  // handled in getRecordBodyID
3774  case A_Null_Record_Definition: // 3.8(3)
3775  // handled in getRecordBodyID
3776  case An_Others_Choice: // 3.8.1(5): 4.3.1(5): 4.3.3(5): 11.2(5)
3777  // handled in case creation (and getDefinitionExpr (obsolete?))
3778  case An_Access_Definition: // 3.10(6/2) -> Access_Definition_Kinds, A2005 start
3779  // handled in getAccessType
3780  case A_Task_Definition: // 9.1(4)
3781  // handled in getTaskSpec
3782  case An_Unknown_Discriminant_Part: // 3.7(3)
3783  //
3784  case A_Known_Discriminant_Part: // 3.7(2)
3785  //
3786  case A_Variant: // 3.8.1(3)
3787  //
3788 
3789  case A_Discrete_Subtype_Definition: // 3.6(6) -> Discrete_Range_Kinds
3790  //
3791  ADA_ASSERT(false);
3792  break;
3793 
3794  case Not_A_Definition: // An unexpected element
3795  case A_Private_Type_Definition: // 7.3(2) -> Trait_Kinds
3796  case A_Tagged_Private_Type_Definition: // 7.3(2) -> Trait_Kinds
3797  case A_Private_Extension_Definition: // 7.3(3) -> Trait_Kinds
3798  case A_Protected_Definition: // 9.4(4)
3799  case A_Formal_Type_Definition: // 12.5(3) -> Formal_Type_Kinds
3800  case An_Aspect_Specification: // 13.3.1, A2012
3801  default:
3802  logWarn() << "unhandled definition kind: " << def.Definition_Kind << std::endl;
3803  ADA_ASSERT (!FAIL_ON_ERROR(ctx));
3804  }
3805 }

3810  ElemIdRange
3811  fromFirstRoutineDeclaration(Declaration_Struct& dcl)
3812  {
3813  // PP (11/14/22): RC-1418 (Asis only?)
3814  // Since Corresponding_Declaration is not set on routines with body stubs,
3815  // the converter reads through Corresponding_Body_Stub to find the
3816  // relevant declaration.
3817 
3818  if (dcl.Corresponding_Declaration > 0)
3819  {
3820  if (Element_Struct* res = retrieveElemOpt(elemMap(), dcl.Corresponding_Declaration))
3821  {
3822  ADA_ASSERT (res->Element_Kind == A_Declaration);
3823  return idRange(res->The_Union.Declaration.Parameter_Profile);
3824  }
3825  }
3826 
3827  if (dcl.Corresponding_Body_Stub > 0)
3828  {
3829  if (Element_Struct* stub = retrieveElemOpt(elemMap(), dcl.Corresponding_Body_Stub))
3830  {
3831  ADA_ASSERT(stub && (stub->Element_Kind == A_Declaration));
3832  return fromFirstRoutineDeclaration(stub->The_Union.Declaration);
3833  }
3834  }
3835 
3836  return idRange(dcl.Parameter_Profile);
3837  }

3839  //~ Parameter_Specification_List
3840  ElemIdRange
3841  secondaryParameters(Declaration_Struct& decl, AstContext)
3842  {
3843  // PP (7/29/22): RC-1372 (Asis only?)
3844  // In the Asis rep. parameter references inside of routine bodies
3845  // refer back to the parameter list of the first declaration.
3846  // Not sure if this is by design or a bug (\todo ask CR or PL).
3847  // As work around, use the first decl's parameter list to
3848  // generate the body's parameter list. Unlike C++, Ada requires
3849  // parameter names AND default initializers of the declaration and
3850  // definition to match.
3851  // One caveat is that multiple initialized names could have a combined
3852  // VariableDeclaration in the declaration, while having separate
3853  // VariableDeclarations in the definition (and vice versa).
3854 
3855  // if the @decl is not a body, use the original parameter list
3856  if ( (decl.Declaration_Kind != A_Procedure_Body_Declaration)
3857  && (decl.Declaration_Kind != A_Function_Body_Declaration)
3858  && (decl.Declaration_Kind != An_Entry_Body_Declaration)
3859  )
3860  return { nullptr, nullptr };
3861 
3862  return fromFirstRoutineDeclaration(decl);
3863  }

3865  Element_ID
3866  secondaryDiscriminants(Element_ID id, Declaration_Struct& decl, AstContext)
3867  {
3868  const bool useThisDecl = ( (decl.Corresponding_Type_Declaration == id)
3869  || (decl.Corresponding_Type_Declaration == 0)
3870  || (decl.Discriminant_Part == 0)
3871  );
3872 
3873  if (useThisDecl) return 0;
3874 
3875  Element_Struct& firstDecl = retrieveElem(elemMap(), decl.Corresponding_Type_Declaration);
3876  ADA_ASSERT(firstDecl.Element_Kind == A_Declaration);
3877 
3878  return firstDecl.The_Union.Declaration.Discriminant_Part;

3881  SgExpression&
3882  getDefaultFunctionExpr(Declaration_Struct& decl, SgAdaSubroutineType& ty, AstContext ctx)
3883  {
3884  SgExpression* res = nullptr;
3885 
3886  switch (decl.Default_Kind)
3887  {
3888  case A_Box_Default:
3889  res = &mkAdaBoxExp();
3890  break;
3891 
3892  case A_Name_Default:
3893  {
3894  SgFunctionParameterList& fnparams = SG_DEREF(ty.get_parameterList());
3895  SgInitializedNamePtrList& parmlst = fnparams.get_args();
3896  OperatorCallSupplement::ArgDescList arglist;
3897  auto argDescExtractor = [](SgInitializedName* ini) -> ArgDesc
3898  {
3899  return { "", ini->get_type() };
3900  };
3901 
3902  arglist.reserve(parmlst.size());
3903  std::transform(parmlst.begin(), parmlst.end(), std::back_inserter(arglist), argDescExtractor);
3904 
3905  res = &getExprID(decl.Formal_Subprogram_Default, ctx, OperatorCallSupplement(std::move(arglist), ty.get_return_type()));
3906  break;
3907  }
3908 
3909  case A_Null_Default:
3910  res = sb::buildNullptrValExp();
3911  break;
3912 
3913  case A_Nil_Default:
3914  res = &mkNullExpression();
3915  break;
3916 
3917  default: ;
3918  }
3919 
3920  return SG_DEREF(res);
3921  }

3923  AstContext::PragmaContainer
3924  splitOfPragmas(std::vector<Element_ID>& pragmaVector, const std::vector<Pragma_Kinds>& splitKinds, const AstContext&)
3925  {
3926  AstContext::PragmaContainer res;
3927 
3928  auto splitPragma = [aaa = splitKinds.begin(), zzz = splitKinds.end()]
3929  (Element_ID pragmaId) -> bool
3930  {
3931  Element_Struct* elem = retrieveElemOpt(elemMap(), pragmaId);
3932 
3933  return ( (elem != nullptr)
3934  && (elem->Element_Kind == A_Pragma)
3935  && (std::find(aaa, zzz, elem->The_Union.The_Pragma.Pragma_Kind) != zzz)
3936  );
3937  };
3938 
3939  auto const beg = pragmaVector.begin();
3940  auto const lim = pragmaVector.end();
3941 
3942  std::copy_if(beg, lim, std::back_inserter(res), splitPragma);
3943  auto const pos = std::remove_if(beg, lim, splitPragma);
3944 
3945  pragmaVector.erase(pos, lim);
3946  return res;
3947  }
3948 
3949  std::vector<Pragma_Kinds> const taskDeclPragmas{ A_Storage_Size_Pragma,
3950  A_Priority_Pragma,
3951  An_Interrupt_Priority_Pragma
3952  };
3953 
3954  std::vector<Pragma_Kinds> const protectedDeclPragmas{ A_Priority_Pragma,
3955  An_Interrupt_Priority_Pragma,
3956  An_Attach_Handler_Pragma,
3957  An_Interrupt_Handler_Pragma
3958  };

3970  Element_ID queryAsisIDOfDeclaration(Declaration_Struct& decl, Declaration_Kinds expected_stub, const AstContext& /* not used */)

3973  return decl.Corresponding_Declaration;

3975  ADA_ASSERT(decl.Corresponding_Body_Stub);
