3986  struct AspectCreator
3987  {
3988  explicit
3989  AspectCreator(AstContext astctx)
3990  : ctx(astctx), args()
3991  {}
3992 
3993  AspectCreator(AspectCreator&&) = default;
3994  AspectCreator& operator=(AspectCreator&&) = default;
3995 
3996  // \todo the following copying functions should be removed post C++17
3997  // @{
3998  AspectCreator(const AspectCreator&) = default;
3999  AspectCreator& operator=(const AspectCreator&) = default;
4000  // @}
4001 
4002  const char* aspectName(Expression_Struct& mark)
4003  {
4004  if (mark.Expression_Kind != An_Identifier) return nullptr;
4005 
4006  return mark.Name_Image;
4007  }
4008 
4009  void operator()(Element_Struct& elem)
4010  {
4011  ADA_ASSERT(elem.Element_Kind == A_Definition);
4012 
4013  Definition_Struct& def = elem.The_Union.Definition;
4014  ADA_ASSERT (def.Definition_Kind == An_Aspect_Specification);
4015 
4016  Aspect_Specification_Struct& asp = def.The_Union.The_Aspect_Specification;
4017 
4018  Element_Struct& aspmark = retrieveElem(elemMap(), asp.Aspect_Mark);
4019  Element_Struct* aspdefn = retrieveElemOpt(elemMap(), asp.Aspect_Definition);
4020 
4021  if ( (aspmark.Element_Kind != An_Expression)
4022  || (aspdefn && (aspdefn->Element_Kind != An_Expression))
4023  )
4024  {
4025  logError() << "Skipping unexpected Aspect representation: "
4026  << aspmark.Element_Kind << "/" << (aspdefn ? aspdefn->Element_Kind : 0)
4027  << std::endl;
4028  return;
4029  }
4030 
4031  Expression_Struct& markex = aspmark.The_Union.Expression;
4032  const char* markname = aspectName(markex);
4033 
4034  if (markname == nullptr)
4035  {
4036  logError() << "Unexpected Aspect mark representation: "
4037  << aspmark.Element_Kind << "/" << (aspdefn ? aspdefn->Element_Kind : 0)
4038  << std::endl;
4039  return;
4040  }
4041 
4042  SgExpression& sgdefn = getExprID_opt(asp.Aspect_Definition, ctx);
4043  SgExpression& sgnode = SG_DEREF(sb::buildActualArgumentExpression(markname, &sgdefn));
4044 
4045  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
4046  args.push_back(&sgnode);
4047  }
4048 
4050  operator SgExprListExp& ()
4051  {
4052  return mkExprListExp(args);
4053  }
4054 
4055  private:
4056  AstContext ctx;
4057  std::vector<SgExpression*> args;
4058 
4059  AspectCreator() = delete;
4060  };

4063  void processAspects(Element_Struct& /*elem*/, Declaration_Struct& decl, SgDeclarationStatement* sgnode, AstContext ctx)
4064  {
4065  ElemIdRange aspectRange = idRange(decl.Aspect_Specifications);
4066 
4067  if (aspectRange.empty()) return;
4068 
4069  if (sgnode == nullptr)
4070  {
4071  logError() << "found aspects w/o corresponding Sage declaration."
4072  << std::endl;
4073  return;
4074  }
4075 
4076  // aspects use deferred elaboration, so that they can use
4077  // type-bound operations defined later in scope.
4078 
4079  auto deferredAspectCompletion =
4080  [sgnode, aspectRange, ctx]()->void
4081  {
4082  SgExprListExp& asplist = traverseIDs(aspectRange, elemMap(), AspectCreator{ctx.pragmaAspectAnchor(*sgnode)});
4083 
4084  sg::linkParentChild(*sgnode, asplist, &SgDeclarationStatement::set_adaAspects);
4085  };
4086 
4087  ctx.storeDeferredUnitCompletion( std::move(deferredAspectCompletion) );
4088  }
4089 }

4096 void handleDeclaration(Element_Struct& elem, AstContext ctx, bool isPrivate)
4097 {
4098  using PragmaContainer = AstContext::PragmaContainer;
4099 
4100  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == A_Declaration);
4101  logKind("A_Declaration", elem.ID);
4102 
4103  SgDeclarationStatement* assocdecl = nullptr;
4104  Declaration_Struct& decl = elem.The_Union.Declaration;
4105  ElemIdRange pragmaRange = idRange(decl.Corresponding_Pragmas);
4106  std::vector<Element_ID> pragmaVector;
4107 
4108  std::copy(pragmaRange.first, pragmaRange.second, std::back_inserter(pragmaVector));
4109 
4110  switch (decl.Declaration_Kind)
4111  {
4112  case A_Package_Declaration: // 7.1(2)
4113  {
4114  logKind("A_Package_Declaration", elem.ID);
4115 
4116  NameData adaname = singleName(decl, ctx);
4117  SgAdaPackageSpecDecl& sgnode = mkAdaPackageSpecDecl(adaname.ident, adaname.parent_scope());
4118  SgAdaPackageSpec& pkgspec = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_definition());
4119 
4120  logTrace() << "package decl " << adaname.ident
4121  << " (" << adaname.fullName << ")"
4122  << std::endl;
4123 
4124  recordNode(asisDecls(), elem.ID, sgnode);
4125  recordNode(asisDecls(), adaname.id(), sgnode);
4126 
4127  privatize(sgnode, isPrivate);
4128  //~ attachSourceLocation(pkgspec, elem, ctx);
4129  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
4130  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
4131 
4132  ADA_ASSERT (sgnode.search_for_symbol_from_symbol_table());
4133 
4134  PragmaContainer pendingPragmas;
4135  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
4136 
4137  // visible items
4138  {
4139  ElemIdRange range = idRange(decl.Visible_Part_Declarative_Items);
4140 
4141  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), ElemCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(pkgspec)});
4142  }
4143 
4144  // private items
4145  {
4146  ElemIdRange range = idRange(decl.Private_Part_Declarative_Items);
4147 
4148  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), ElemCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(pkgspec), true /* private items */});
4149 
4150  // a package may contain an empty private section
4151  pkgspec.set_hasPrivate(decl.Is_Private_Present);
4152  }
4153 
4154  // \todo consider:
4155  // currently, missing built-in function declarations are generated when needed
4156  // a more principled implementation could generate them here, but they still would
4157  // need to be identified when needed.
4158  // generateBuiltinFunctionsOnTypes(ctx.scope(pkgspec));
4159 
4160  processAndPlacePragmas(decl.Pragmas, { &pkgspec }, pragmaCtx.scope(pkgspec));
4161  //~ computeSourceRangeFromChildren(pkgspec);
4162 
4163  /* unused nodes:
4164  Element_ID Corresponding_End_Name;
4165  bool Is_Name_Repeated;
4166  Declaration_ID Corresponding_Declaration;
4167  */
4168 
4169  assocdecl = &sgnode;
4170  break;
4171  }
4172 
4173  case A_Package_Body_Declaration: // 7.2(2)
4174  {
4175  logKind("A_Package_Body_Declaration", elem.ID);
4176 
4177  Element_ID specID = queryAsisIDOfDeclaration(decl, A_Package_Body_Stub, ctx);
4178  // we need to check if the SgAdaPackageSpecDecl is directly available
4179  // or if it is wrapped by an SgAdaGenericDecl node.
4180  SgDeclarationStatement& declnode = lookupNode(asisDecls(), specID);
4181  SgAdaPackageSpecDecl* specdcl = getAdaPackageSpecDecl(&declnode);
4182 
4183  // unhandled package bodies
4184  ADA_ASSERT(specdcl != nullptr);
4185 
4186  SgDeclarationStatement* ndef = findFirst(asisDecls(), decl.Corresponding_Body_Stub);
4187  SgAdaPackageBodyDecl* nondef = isSgAdaPackageBodyDecl(ndef);
4188  ADA_ASSERT(!ndef || nondef); // ndef => nondef
4189 
4190  // when this is an implementation of a stub, use the scope of the stub, instead of the global scope
4191  SgScopeStatement& logicalScope = nondef ? SG_DEREF(nondef->get_scope())
4192  : singleName(decl, ctx).parent_scope();

4195  SgAdaPackageBody& pkgbody = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_definition());
4196 
4197  recordNode(asisDecls(), elem.ID, sgnode);
4198  //~ recordNode(asisDecls(), adaname.id(), sgnode);
4199 
4200  sgnode.set_scope(specdcl->get_scope());
4201  //~ attachSourceLocation(pkgbody, elem, ctx);
4202  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
4203  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
4204 
4205  const bool hasBodyStatements = idRange(decl.Body_Statements).size() > 0;
4206 
4207  completeDeclarationsWithHandledBlock( decl.Body_Declarative_Items,
4208  decl.Body_Statements,
4209  decl.Body_Exception_Handlers,
4210  decl.Pragmas,
4211  routineBlockHandler,
4212  routineExceptionBlockHandler,
4213  pkgbody,
4214  hasBodyStatements /* create new block for statements if needed */,
4215  ctx
4216  );
4217 
4218  /*
4219  * unused nodes:
4220  Element_ID Corresponding_End_Name;
4221  Declaration_ID Body_Block_Statement;
4222  bool Is_Name_Repeated;
4223  bool Is_Subunit;
4224  */

4226  break;

4229  case A_Generic_Package_Declaration: // 12.1(2)
4230  {

4232 
4233  NameData adaname = singleName(decl, ctx);
4234  // create generic declaration
4235  SgScopeStatement& logicalScope = adaname.parent_scope();

4237  SgAdaGenericDefn& gen_defn = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_definition());

4239  // create package in the scope of the generic

4263  ADA_ASSERT (pkgnode.search_for_symbol_from_symbol_table());

4276 
4277  // visible items
4278  {
4279  ElemIdRange range = idRange(decl.Visible_Part_Declarative_Items);
4280 
4281  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), ElemCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(pkgspec)});
4282  }
4283 
4284  // private items
4285  {
4286  ElemIdRange range = idRange(decl.Private_Part_Declarative_Items);
4287

4289  }

4291  processAndPlacePragmas(decl.Pragmas, { &pkgspec }, pragmaCtx.scope(pkgspec));
4292 
4293  /* unused nodes:
4294  Element_ID Corresponding_End_Name;
4295  bool Is_Name_Repeated;
4296  Declaration_ID Corresponding_Declaration;
4297  */

4300  }

4302  case A_Generic_Procedure_Declaration: // 12.1(2)
4303  case A_Generic_Function_Declaration: // 12.1(2)
4304  {
4305  logKind( decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Generic_Function_Declaration
4306  ? "A_Generic_Function_Declaration"
4307  : "A_Generic_Procedure_Declaration"
4308  , elem.ID
4309  );

4312  NameData adaname = singleName(decl, ctx);
4313  SgScopeStatement& logicalScope = adaname.parent_scope();
4314 
4315  // PP (20/10/21): the assertion does not hold for proc/func defined in their own unit
4316  //~ ADA_ASSERT (adaname.fullName == adaname.ident);

4318  SgAdaGenericDefn& gen_defn = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_definition());

4328  {

4334  ElemIdRange params = idRange(decl.Parameter_Profile);
4335  SgType& rettype = isFunc ? getDeclTypeID(decl.Result_Profile, ctx)

4342  gen_defn, //~ logicalScope,
4343  rettype,
4344  ParameterCompletion{params, ctx}
4345  );

4350  setOverride(fundec, decl.Is_Overriding_Declaration);

4352  recordNode(asisDecls(), elem.ID, sgnode);

4360  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, elem, ctx);
4361  //~ attachSourceLocation(gen_defn, elem, ctx);

4364 
4365  /* unhandled fields

4425  case A_Procedure_Body_Declaration: // 6.3(2)
4426  {

4428  logKind("A_Function_Body_Declaration", elem.ID);
4429  else if (decl.Declaration_Kind == A_Procedure_Body_Declaration)

4445  SgFunctionDeclaration* nondef = getFunctionDeclaration(ndef ? ndef->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration() : nullptr);
4446  ADA_ASSERT(!ndef || nondef); // ndef => nondef

4448  //~ logError() << "proc body: " << nondef << std::endl;

4472  if (decl.Declaration_Kind != A_Null_Procedure_Declaration)

4480  +func:

4483  break;

4493  {
4494  logKind( decl.Declaration_Kind == An_Incomplete_Type_Declaration
4495  ? "An_Incomplete_Type_Declaration"
4496  : "A_Tagged_Incomplete_Type_Declaration"
4497  , elem.ID
4498  );

4500  if (decl.Corresponding_Type_Declaration)
4501  {
4502  // \todo handle pragmas in opaque types
4503  assocdecl = &handleOpaqueTypes(elem, decl, isPrivate, ctx);
4504  }
4505  else
4506  {

4509  ADA_ASSERT (adaname.fullName == adaname.ident);

5666  // \todo handle pragmas and aspects on these elements
5667  case An_Entry_Index_Specification: // 9.5.2(2)
5668  // handled by EntryIndexCompletion;
5669  case A_Choice_Parameter_Specification: // 11.2(4)
5670  // handled in handleExceptionHandler
5671  case An_Enumeration_Literal_Specification: // 3.5.1(3)
5672  // handled in EnumElementCreator
5673  case A_Discriminant_Specification: // 3.7(5) -> Trait_Kinds
5674  // handled in getDiscriminant
5675  ADA_ASSERT(false);
5676  break;
5677 
5678  case Not_A_Declaration: // An unexpected element
5679  case A_Generalized_Iterator_Specification: // 5.5.2 -> Trait_Kinds (Ada 2012)
5680  case An_Element_Iterator_Specification: // 5.5.2 -> Trait_Kinds (Ada 2012)
5681  case A_Return_Variable_Specification: // 6.5 (Ada 2005)
5682  case A_Return_Constant_Specification: // 6.5 (Ada 2005)
5683  case A_Formal_Incomplete_Type_Declaration: // (Ada 2012)
5684  default:
5685  logWarn() << "unhandled declaration kind: " << decl.Declaration_Kind << std::endl;
5686  ADA_ASSERT (!FAIL_ON_ERROR(ctx));
5687  }
5688 
5689  processAspects(elem, decl, assocdecl, ctx);
5690  recordPragmasID(std::move(pragmaVector), assocdecl, ctx);
5691 }

5721 NameData
5722 getName(Element_Struct& elem, AstContext ctx)
5723 {
5724  // \todo can getName be distinguished from getQualName by the call context?
5725  if (elem.Element_Kind == An_Expression)
5726  return getQualName(elem, ctx);
5727 
5728  if (elem.Element_Kind != A_Defining_Name)
5729  logWarn() << "unexpected elem kind (getName)" << elem.Element_Kind << std::endl;
5730 
5731  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == A_Defining_Name);
5732  logKind("A_Defining_Name", elem.ID);
5733 
5734  Defining_Name_Struct& asisname = elem.The_Union.Defining_Name;
5735  SgScopeStatement* parent = &ctx.scope();
5736  std::string ident{asisname.Defining_Name_Image};
5737  std::string name{ident};
5738 
5739  switch (asisname.Defining_Name_Kind)
5740  {
5741  case A_Defining_Expanded_Name:
5742  {
5743  logKind("A_Defining_Expanded_Name", elem.ID);
5744 
5745  NameData defname = getNameID(asisname.Defining_Selector, ctx);
5746 
5747  ident = defname.ident;
5748  parent = &queryScopeOfID(asisname.Defining_Prefix, ctx);
5749  break;
5750  }
5751 
5752  case A_Defining_Identifier:
5753  {
5754  logKind("A_Defining_Identifier", elem.ID);
5755 
5756  //~ logTrace() << "* " << ident << std::endl;
5757  // nothing to do, the fields are already set
5758  break;
5759  }
5760 
5761  case A_Defining_Operator_Symbol: // 6.1(9)
5762  {
5763  logKind("A_Defining_Operator_Symbol", elem.ID);
5764 
5765  ADA_ASSERT (ident.size() > 2);
5766  name = ident = si::Ada::roseOperatorPrefix + ident.substr(1, ident.size() - 2);
5767 
5768  // nothing to do, the fields are already set
5769 
5770  /* unused field:
5771  enum Operator_Kinds Operator_Kind
5772  */
5773  break;
5774  }
5775 
5776  case A_Defining_Enumeration_Literal: // 3.5.1(3)
5777  {
5778  logKind("A_Defining_Enumeration_Literal", elem.ID);
5779 
5780  /* unused fields:
5781  char* Position_Number_Image; // \pp implied by name sequence
5782  char* Representation_Value_Image; // \pp not in code, but could be defined by representation clause
5783  */
5784  break;
5785  }
5786 
5787  case A_Defining_Character_Literal: // 3.5.1(4)
5788  {
5789  logKind("A_Defining_Enumeration_Literal", elem.ID);
5790 
5791  logWarn() << "a A_Defining_Character_Literal (reconsider translation)"
5792  << " (" << name << ")"
5793  << std::endl;
5794  break;
5795  }
5796 
5797  case Not_A_Defining_Name:
5798  /* break; */
5799 
5800  default:
5801  logWarn() << "unknown name kind " << asisname.Defining_Name_Kind
5802  << " (" << name << ")"
5803  << std::endl;
5804  ADA_ASSERT (!FAIL_ON_ERROR(ctx));
5805  }
5806 
5807  return NameData{ ident, name, SG_DEREF(parent), elem };
5808 }
5809 
5810 NameData
5811 getQualName(Element_Struct& elem, AstContext ctx)
5812 {
5813  ADA_ASSERT (elem.Element_Kind == An_Expression);
5814 
5815  Expression_Struct& idex = elem.The_Union.Expression;
5816 
5817  if (idex.Expression_Kind == An_Identifier)
5818  {
5819  logKind("An_Identifier", elem.ID);
5820 
5821  std::string ident{idex.Name_Image};
5822 
5823  return NameData{ ident, ident, ctx.scope(), elem };
5824  }
5825 
5826  if (idex.Expression_Kind == An_Operator_Symbol)
5827  {
5828  logKind("An_Operator_Symbol", elem.ID);
5829 
5830  std::string ident{idex.Name_Image};
5831 
5832  return NameData{ ident, ident, ctx.scope(), elem };
5833  }
5834 
5835  if (idex.Expression_Kind == An_Attribute_Reference)
5836  {
5837  NameData prefix = getNameID(idex.Prefix, ctx);
5838  NameData attr = getNameID(idex.Attribute_Designator_Identifier, ctx);
5839 
5840  return NameData{ prefix.ident, prefix.fullName + "'" + attr.fullName, ctx.scope(), prefix.elem() };
5841  }
5842 
5843  if (idex.Expression_Kind != A_Selected_Component)
5844  logError() << "Unexpected Expression_kind [getQualName]: " << idex.Expression_Kind
5845  << ( elem.Source_Location.Unit_Name ? elem.Source_Location.Unit_Name : "" )
5846  << " @" << elem.Source_Location.First_Line << ":" << elem.Source_Location.First_Column
5847  << std::endl;
5848 
5849  ADA_ASSERT (idex.Expression_Kind == A_Selected_Component);
5850  logKind("A_Selected_Component", elem.ID);
5851 
5852  NameData compound = getNameID(idex.Prefix, ctx);
5853  NameData selected = getNameID(idex.Selector, ctx);
5854 
5855  return NameData{ selected.ident,
5856  compound.fullName + "." + selected.fullName,
5857  ctx.scope(),
5858  selected.elem()
5859  };
5860 }

5868 void
5869 processInheritedSubroutines( SgNamedType& derivedType,
5870  ElemIdRange subprograms,
5871  ElemIdRange declarations,
5872  AstContext ctx
5873  )
5874 {
5875  // use a deferred unit completion, so that all information of records
5876  // (i.e., detailed inheritance relationship) have been seen when
5877  // the inherited subroutines are processed.
5878  auto deferredSubRoutineProcessing =
5879  [&derivedType, subprograms, declarations, ctx]() -> void
5880  {
5881  SgType* baseType = si::Ada::baseType(derivedType);
5882  SgType* baseRootRaw = si::Ada::typeRoot(baseType).typerep();
5883  SgNamedType* baseRootType = isSgNamedType(baseRootRaw);
5884 
5885  if (baseRootType == nullptr)
5886  {
5887  // if baseRootRaw != nullptr
5888  // it will correspond to a universal type in package standard.
5889  // -> not an error
5890  if (baseRootRaw == nullptr)
5891  logFlaw() << "unable to find any base-root for " << derivedType.get_name()
5892  << " / base = " << baseType
5893  << std::endl;
5894  return;
5895  }
5896 
5897  //~ logWarn() << "drv: " << derivedType.get_name() << " / " << baseRootType->get_name()
5898  //~ << std::endl;
5899  traverseIDs(subprograms, elemMap(), InheritedSymbolCreator{*baseRootType, derivedType, ctx});
5900 
5901  if (!declarations.empty())
5902  {
5903  // fields will be added later during the fixup pass: FixupAstSymbolTablesToSupportAliasedSymbols
5904  // \todo also implement fixup for discriminants and enumerations..
5905  logInfo() << "A derived/extension record type's implicit declaration is not empty: "
5906  << derivedType.get_name()
5907  << std::endl;
5908  }
5909  };
5910 
5911  ctx.storeDeferredUnitCompletion(std::move(deferredSubRoutineProcessing));
5912 }

5914 void processAndPlacePragmas(Pragma_Element_ID_List pragmalst, std::vector<SgScopeStatement*> scopes, AstContext ctx)

5917  ElemIdRange pragmaRange = idRange(pragmalst);

5921  recordPragmasID(std::move(pragmaVector), nullptr /* no available statement */, ctx);
5922 
5923  placePragmas(std::move(scopes), ctx);
5924 }
